missions/star_1_mission_01/task: The Dolores Prime garrison is too small to hold back the Swarm. We must request backup from the neighboring planets. The comm tower blocked by the bugs is in District 37. We must clear the sector and retake the tower.
missions/star_1_mission_02/task: Command is removing the genetic samples which were developed as part of the super-soldier program from the planet. We have been ordered to secure the convoy's passage through the combat zone.
missions/star_1_mission_03/task: Now that the genetic material is safe, we've been ordered to destroy the genetic modules so the Swarm can't use the Space Infantry soldiers' DNA to create new bug species. Let's start now!
missions/star_1_mission_04/task: The colony governor sent us the coordinates of the secret site code-named Dinosaur. It's a war factory on the planet Oberon that was seized by the bugs. The factory's still holding out. We must evac the scientists and their research.
missions/star_1_mission_05/task: We received a distress signal from the mining colony on Gadalur. The message was sent automatically. It's not clear what's actually going on there. If the colony was attacked by the bugs, we must carry out an evac.
missions/star_1_mission_06/task: The Gadalur colony was destroyed, but a few miners escaped. They mentioned a giant bug supposedly controlling the others. If this is true, we need to explore where the bugs congregate and find a new specimen of the Swarm.
missions/star_1_mission_07/task: The Swarm's biomass density on Gadalur exceeds that found on Dolores Prime. That means the source of the invasion is here! We found the Big Bug and drove it into the canyon. It's time to purge the system of the Swarm.
missions/star_2_mission_01/task: We've received an emergency message from the Aurelia system. The Space Infantry's headquarters on Karradas was attacked by the Blue Swarm. It is not clear where the bugs come from, but our star fleet is the closest and it is ready to begin landing troops.
missions/star_2_mission_02/task: According to the intel data the bugs crawled from the technical catacombs under the city. These tunnels stretch for many miles around. We don't know how many creatures are hiding in them. The command is going to use gas and we won't allow the bugs to get outside.
missions/star_2_mission_03/task: The bugs were more numerous than expected. The barrier troops were halved. First of all, the White Consul ordered that a full-scale military base be deployed on Karradas. We were ordered to clear the landing area for the transport ships.
missions/star_2_mission_04/task: The base established on Karradas badly lacks resources. Industrial warehouses with metal and crystallites have been found about one hundred and seventy miles to the east of here. We have been instructed to seize and confiscate the contents of the warehouses.
missions/star_2_mission_05/task: We've received a message on the private channel. The Secret Center for Bug Studies on Nephrit has asked us to assist in the capture of several samples of the Swarm that have escaped from the laboratory. Nephrite is a planet covered with jungles, so this won't be an easy task.
missions/star_2_mission_06/task: We're late. The new bug species, bred by mixing human DNA and the Swarm's biomass, destroyed all of the research center personnel. We need to regain control over the lab, take all the data and blow up the building.
missions/star_2_mission_07/task: General! We've lost contact with the Tarantula military base, where the main Space Infantry garrison on Nephrite is located. Our drones were shot down near the base by the base's air defenses, so the only way to get there is to cross the jungle.
missions/star_2_mission_08/task: Base Tarantula was captured by the bugs. They somehow managed to exploit a glitch in the anti-aircraft defenses, but the technicians manually cut the power to the guns. Data indicates that the base has a number of Peacemaker armor suits. We can take and use them for our own purposes.
missions/star_2_mission_09/task: Urgent Message! Corinth IV is under attack from the Swarm's enormous forces. Command has thrown all the fleets in the area at it to stop the invasion. We should immediately prepare for landing... and, sir... this is my home planet.
missions/star_2_mission_10/task: The military Academy on Corinth IV trains the Space Infantry officers. According to satellite images, the bugs are concentrating forces to attack the Academy. We have been instructed to keep the security perimeter at all costs.
missions/star_2_mission_11/task: Apparently the Swarm's attack on Corinth is the last attempt to change the course of war. Deep underground we found a ship with the primordial biomass better known as the Mother. If we fight our way to the mine and destroy the Mother, the war for the Aurelia will be won.
missions/star_3_mission_01/task: General! We've received an urgent message from the Machine Cult. The Santum system is attacked by the robots of the Logos. They captured the space station and are going to launch a nuclear strike. The Master of Machines asks to stop the launch.
missions/star_3_mission_02/task: Logos squads are trying to fight their way to the Central Reliquary to get the secret data that is there. The attack took the Cult by surprise and it seems that the Reliquary will be lost if we don't help.
missions/star_3_mission_03/task: We received a signal from Circe, where the Machine Cult's genetic modules are. Logos landing ships have breached the defensive perimeter. They are after the Machine Knights' hereditary codes. Losing them will bring the Cult to its knees.
missions/star_3_mission_04/task: Logos concentrates enormous force to breach the defense of Circe. The Machine Cult needs time to withdraw the genetic code. If we can win back at least one of the military airfields we'll hold the robots with aircraft.
missions/star_3_mission_05/task: While the main forces of the Machine Cult have been concentrated on Сallahan, the Logos attacks the resource bases on Orb III. The Master of Machines asks us to land and regain control of the planet.
missions/star_3_mission_06/task: General! We observed enemy transport activity in sector R-12. Our data shows that the Cult keeps military storage facilities there. Logos intends to extract their contents. Let's deliver a preemptive strike.
missions/star_3_mission_07/task: The Master of Machines gave us the coordinates of the Typhon military research center on Orb III. The base has been declassified and defined by the Logos as a priority target. Hurry up, we need to get to Typhon first!
missions/star_3_mission_08/task: We've captured an enemy information module and found out that more than hundreds Devastators were delivered to Orb. These machines can wipe all life off the face of the planet in a few hours. We can't allow Logos to activate them!
missions/star_3_mission_09/task: General! Robots are leaving Orb III and moving to sector Zeta 9. Judging by the signature of the object detected there it's a command cruiser of the Logos. Despite the lack of firepower we can try to attack it while the enemy is weak!
missions/star_3_mission_10/task: Great news! Our boarding team has just disabled the weapon systems of the cruiser. Now we have to capture the central reactor and prevent the Logos ship from passage through the space gate.
missions/star_3_mission_11/task: General! We can not get through to the reactor! An automatic turret blocks all ways. We have to deactivate the security system of the cruiser to reach the goal. If we can not deactivate it the boarding teams will be doomed!
missions/star_3_mission_12/task: Excellent work, sir! Turrets are turned off, the reactor is stopped. Wait... I have just received a report ... Logos activated the self-destruct system of the cruiser. We have to mop up the landing deck to evacuate the soldiers!
missions/star_4_mission_01/task: We detected a Logos intrusion in the Phoenix Feather system. The robots have attacked Fleya, the system's capital. First, the Confederation wants to evac the governor and his family. Our fleet is the closest one to Fleya. Will you give the order to deploy our troops?
missions/star_4_mission_02/task: An active evacuation of civilians takes place on the Fleya. The Confederate fighters cover the shuttles in the air and in the orbit, but the defenses of the central spaceport are about to fall. We are being asked to land and secure the perimeter.
missions/star_4_mission_03/task: Bad news, General. The robots broke through to the planetary guns. A few shuttles are down. The fleet in the orbit is under fire. If we don't retrieve the guns, the evacuation mission will fail.
missions/star_4_mission_04/task: The Logos attack the strategic targets throughout the system. Miners at the Bore-3 station have been attacked by their own robots. I think a diversion module of the Logos sneaked to the station. If we don't find it, all the resources of Bore-3 will be lost, as well as the miners.
missions/star_4_mission_05/task: The miners are safe, but the scanners have recorded the Logos in the tech facility of the Bore. As we know, the main life-support systems are located there. If the Logos gain control of the unit, it will make our lives significantly harder.
missions/star_4_mission_06/task: This is urgent! The attack on the tech facility was a trick. The Logos are about to blow up the thermonuclear reactor! Our analysts estimate that the explosion will destroy all of Boor's resource supplies. The system's economy would never recover from a blow like that...
missions/star_4_mission_07/task: Sir, Logos fleets come from sector XB- 6. Judging by the signature we are dealing with a battle station of enormous size. The Confederates are going to attack it with the Cult of the Machine. All loyal generals have already agreed to participate in the operation.
missions/star_4_mission_08/task: Good work, General - protective weaponry is disabled. Reinforcements are coming up but the main machine forces will be here first. We have reprogrammed several turrets on the landing strip. Now it is the perfect place for defense.
missions/star_4_mission_09/task: Judging by the station blueprints, the data cluster, which is a kind of a think tank for the robots is located on board. Even the Machine Knights were not able to capture this device, so get ready for fierce resistance.
missions/star_4_mission_10/task: Our engineers have started to crack the data cluster and here are the first results. The ZOG station is not just a battle center. It is a small spatial gate leading to the native system of the Logos called Platea.  Destroy the station and the invasion of the robots will be stopped!
missions/star_4_mission_11/task: Sir, I have just received a report from the Hive...  the defensive system of the most heavily populated planet in Phoenix Feather is completely offline. The residential areas are swarming with the Logos. We are capable of stopping this massacre, General. Orders the landing on the Hive!
missions/star_4_mission_12/task: We lost contact with the Master of Machines on Glados. The comm channels are a mess! The colonial defense forces reported that the Cult's knights are attacking their garrisons! We need to send a fleet to find out what's going on there.
missions/star_4_mission_13/task: I can't believe it! The Machine Knights are killing the humans on Hive! Glados's garrisons fell! The satellites detected some ballistic missiles launched from the Cult's bases. They are heading straight for the planet's biggest cities. We must stop them.
missions/star_4_mission_14/task: An urgent message! Logos somehow hacked the Master of Machines's defense systems and uploaded modified directives. This explains the knights' betrayal and means that we must destroy the Master. There is no other way to save the Phoenix Feather!

missions/spaceport_mission_04/task: Get to the source of the signal.
missions/spaceport_mission_05/task: Free the scientist and get to the evacuation site.
missions/spaceport_mission_06/task: Hold the line until the rescue shuttle arrives.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_01/task: A research team led by Lee Wayne went missing from the Strata system. The Council believes their disappearance has something to do with the Iron Griffins pirate clan near the planet Chion. We've been asked to find Wayne.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_02/task: We tailed the Griffin ship to planet Eugene. They tried to break away in an asteroid belt, but we shot them. The pirates' escape pods have landed at the equator. We should attack them now while we know their location!
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_03/task: When questioned, the Griffins mentioned the ship Shiva, a written-off cruiser they use to carry cargo. We've determined where the ship is, so now we can intercept it.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_04/task: General, the Shiva's cargo is a combat stimulators pack code-named Zodiac. Right now he's probably in an underground Griffin factory on the planet Salm. The Council has OK'ed a capture mission.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_05/task: Wayne was transferred to another base. There's no point in looking for him as long as the Griffins remain funded. First we need to hit their in-house bank in Eugene's orbit.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_06/task: The pirates' financial support is disrupted. Our informers are reporting that the Griffins' command is fleeing and a self-destruct sequence has commenced in their coordination center on Chion! We need to seize their data block ASAP.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_07/task: Chion is in utter chaos. We eliminated the remaining Griffins and obtained their data block. The Mandrake base must contain information on the location of Wayne and his people.
missions/ch_1_s_1_mission_08/task: General, Wayne is in the lab on the planet of Camp 8. We can find both our scientists and the first test subjects of Project Zodiac there. We need to stay sharp. I suggest we proceed with the assault.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_01/task: We intercepted a signal from P-7 Station, which orbits planet Gemini in the Aid system. The Swarm captured Aid 20 years ago and the Confederation evacuated the colonists. No one is expecting us except bugs and the signal's sender.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_02/task: Someone was here and left a message. "This is Mark Wyrn. Tornton base is under siege - we need the Union's help!" Data indicates that Mark Wyrn, head of the Gemini colonists, was killed 20 years ago. This looks like a trap.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_03/task: I'm Mark Wyrn, head of the Union of the Forsaken. We formed this union exactly 20 years ago, when the Confederation abandoned us. Your aid has come too late. Want to be useful? Drive the bugs back to the defense turrets.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_04/task: Great! No one from the Union of the Forsaken is leaving Aid until we defend this system! This is our land! Don't worry, I have a plan. First, we need to regain control over the Way-3 coordination center on Gemini.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_05/task: I'm at Way-3. Sensors are showing the colonies' power shields as dead. Have your soldiers replace the power supply units, or we won't last. Start with Gemini. We have a power supply unit, so fight your way to the shield generator and install it.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_06/task: Now for Pier-2. The shuttle that was carrying the new power supply unit crashed in the wasteland. The on-board computer failed and the crew had to abandon ship. By now it must be swarming with bugs. Go there and get the power supply unit.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_07/task: There's a group here called the Recluses. They refuse to fight for our cause and are hiding on the ship Katana. Traitors! Not long ago, they captured the power supply unit from the Zyx colony. We will retrieve it with your help.
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_08/task: Varrus colony has a similar problem. They lost contact with the power supply shuttle. It was probably captured by the Swarm or the Recluses. The ship is hovering in orbit and is not responding. Hurry! The colony's shields will stop soon!
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_09/task: The Swarm wasn't stopped by the orbital guns, which were disabled due to a failure at the Zyx power plant. When we figured out the problem we found it to be full of bugs, and we were short on people. Now, we can break through and restart the generator!
missions/ch_1_s_2_mission_10/task: We're getting close to the generator. Damn it! Unbelievable! The Swarm's Mother! She's been here all these years, absorbing the power of the generator. General, the place is full of... *static* ...we need backup... *static*.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_01/name: The Gate to the Gorgon System
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_01/task: Thanks to your success in the Aid system, we can isolate the Swarm on Baloria again. The Confederate fleet is moving to the space gate. Your job is to destroy the asteroids that are keeping the Titan ships from entering the Gorgon system.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_02/task: Our next step is deploying an operations HQ on Tsuntree. The old orbital guns will keep the ships away - they'll recognize us as a foe. Drop a task force from the recon shuttles and disable the control station.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_03/task: We conducted an initial bombardment of Tsuntree, but our ships are unable to land for now. To land and start deploying the HQ, we need to wipe out the bugs still on the planet's surface.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_04/task: During the First Isolation of Baloria, the quarantine modules were supervised by the Tsuntree's Blackwall base. To get the modules running again you have to go there and start the generator.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_05/task: Looks like the modules have incorrect coordinates. They should have been saved in the main computer on Icarus-2 Station, which orbits Baloria. Go there and enter the correct coordinates into the autopilot system.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_06/task: While retreating, most of our team... *static* ...the Swarm is everywhere! We entered the correct coordinates into the Icarus-2 station's computer, but we urgently need... *static* ...requesting evac... *static*
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_07/task: General, after the quarantine network was activated in Baloria's orbit we lost contact with the Bellerophon cruiser. It went off course and might take the modules with it. Go to the ship, find out what happened and alter its route.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_08/task: Emergency! We don't know what happened but it looks like the Mother downed the Hades by discharging organic matter. The ship crash-landed on Baloria. The Black Consul and his men hid in the old Polyphemus observatory.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_09/task: The motion tracker shows that the Black Consul and his men have barricaded themselves in the observatory's dome. We will send a rescue shuttle if you can get inside and open the dome. Hurry, or the bugs will get there first!
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_10/task: Baloria is no longer a threat. The Mother on Tsuntree is now our target. Our soil scorcher, which was holding her back, is disabled. We need to get it running again and I think I know who can fix this problem.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_11/task: The soil scorcher is a provisional measure. The only way to kill the Mother forever is by destroying Tsuntree. I've given the order to deploy thermonuclear charges in the deep mines. Clear the path for my engineers.
missions/ch_1_s_3_mission_12/task: We planted the thermonuclear charges, but one of the engineering teams got trapped when the tunnel entrance collapsed. We can't stop the timer now! We need to extract them before it blows!
missions/ch_2_1_mission_01/task: The owner of the ship Ulysses, Tom Blaine, has contacted us. He's been delivering parts for the Confederation's cruisers, but one of his vessels has been lost in the Mor system. Blaine is asking us to go to the planet Khem, where the Ulysses was last seen.
missions/ch_2_1_mission_02/task: The Ulysses was shot down by pirates from the Iron Griffins clan, who flew here from Aid. They set up an SOS beacon and an ambush! Our scanner has located their base, and we can't let them keep attacking ships like this.
missions/ch_2_1_mission_03/task: You have two new messages. The first is from Blaine: "My boys are gone forever, but now their deaths are avenged. I'm in your debt." The second is anonymous: "The crash of the Ulysses was arranged. It's all a setup! You can find proof on the planet Werb. Coordinates attached."
missions/ch_2_1_mission_04/task: We bumped into some unknown mercenaries and found the cargo the Ulysses was carrying. Looks like the vessel swapped out its real cargo for some discarded parts from the space cruiser graveyard around the planet Errato. We have to get to the bottom of this.
missions/ch_2_1_mission_05/task: We've captured a few pirates, and they say they made a deal with Blaine that got them the cruiser parts. But to find out how he profited from all of this, we need to access data from the offshore bank he used on Lokk 9 Station.
missions/ch_2_1_mission_06/task: Blaine was nearly bankrupt, so he did this to collect insurance payments from the bank equal to the value of the ship and the "lost" cargo. Confederation radar has determined his current location: Navi Base. We need to get over there before he leaves the system!
missions/ch_2_1_mission_07/task: The pirates got here first! The main group captured Blaine and left the planet. But it looks like those vultures have another hostage, too - a girl. They've barricaded themselves in the bunker. We've got to get her out - she might know something.
missions/ch_2_1_mission_08/task: I'm Blaine's sister, Reya. I found out about the fraudulent deal and didn't want to betray the Confederation, so I hid here and sent you that anonymous message. Tom found me and asked me to return to the team, but these vultures caught us off guard and took him to their Chrome Stronghold.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_01/ta: We are prepared to dock at the Guard-13 defensive station, once an outpost of the Confederation. It appears to be the epicenter of a protracted battle! We must defend the captain's bridge, or Guard-13 won't have a command staff for long!
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_02/ta: The commander says the station is almost completely under Swarm control. And the bugs just keep coming! We've got to break through to the combat center first so we can check the status of the station's modules and reinitialize the automated defense system.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_03/ta: The system says some of the crew could still be trapped in the station's living quarters module, but the main corridor to that module is locked down. We'll have to use the service deck to access it.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_04/ta: General, the central bridge is the key to the station's defenses. We've got to clear the bugs out of it if we want to make any progress!
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_05/ta: General, I bet there are still survivors in sickbay! The station commander has asked us to clear the sector and get the survivors out.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_06/ta: The system is showing an unidentified object stuck in Guard-13's hull. It looks like a huge asteroid tore into the hull and got stuck. That's where the bugs are coming from!
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_07/ta: The bugs arrived at our station on huge biomass asteroids! We've got to fry the Swarm along the outer perimeter so our crew can start repairing the hull.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_08/ta: During the attack, nearly all of the life support systems in the Guard's generator module were disabled. To start them working again and open the access corridor, we need to get to the data center computers.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_09/ta: General! An alarm has just been triggered in the quantum reactor coolant system! Looks like the bugs have hit that module, too. I'm sure you understand the danger we're in if we don't handle this immediately!
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_10/ta: These bugs really multiply in the rec room's artificial warmth. We've got to destroy the Swarm's eggs, unless we want another invasion!
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_11/ta: The force field generators will shut down any minute now, leaving Guard-13 defenseless! General, we've got to clear the generator module of Swarm bugs so our repair crew can get to work.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_12/ta: General, a huge asteroid filled with bugs is hovering right by our station. We can stop these attacks if we destroy it, but first we have to clear out the Sieve and prepare to launch our attack from there.
missions/event_1_red_swarm_mission_13/ta: General, if we destroy the bugs on that asteroid, our techs will be able to push it away from the station and destroy it with the planetary guns. It's time to put a stop to these Red Swarm attacks once and for all!

quests/expedition_resources/planet: The automated geoexploration module located a small mineral resources deposit. All the resources extracted.
quests/expedition_resources/trash: Sir! We found the traces of a fierce battle. Valuable materials are found among the wrecks.
quests/expedition_resources/station: We located an abandoned station the pirates used as a storage facility. We've taken the resources and sealed the entrances.
quests/expedition_schemes/planet: We found an unidentified drone transporting valuable data. The data were copied and the drone was destroyed.
quests/expedition_schemes/station_1: We found the smugglers' trading post. They were able to hide, but they left a few data modules in a hurry.
quests/expedition_schemes/station_2: We took part in an experiment at the Prometheus research station. To thank us, the researchers shared some secret prototypes with us.
quests/expedition_recruits/planet: We helped a small military squad to defend against a bug attack. In gratitude the commander gave us a few soldiers.
quests/expedition_recruits/trash: We located a mercenary base in the asteroid belt. They know about your feats and want to work for the Confederation!
quests/expedition_recruits/station: We picked up a slave trader signal and attacked their ship. Some of the rescued people wanted to join us.
quests/expedition_expendables/planet: We intercepted a distress signal from an underground base in sector 4-A. It was abandoned, but we found stored supplies.
quests/expedition_expendables/trash: We've found a drifting ammo container. Apparently, it was lost by the smugglers.
quests/expedition_expendables/station: We managed to capture ammo from the automated munitions factory of Logos! It seems we were not noticed...
quests/expedition_schemes_expendables/pl: A few data modules and a couple of ammo crates are a worthy reward for saving the colony from terrorists!
quests/expedition_schemes_expendables/tr: The mercenary frigate sent a distress signal too late. Data modules and ammo were found among the drifting debris.
quests/expedition_schemes_expendables/st: We found a space pirate stash at the old drilling station. All of the valuables were seized, and the station sealed.
quests/expedition_recruits_expendables/p: We sent some humanitarian aid to one of the smaller colonies. To thank us, they sent us some recruits and ammo.
A smal mercenary destroyer made ​​a hard landing in the mountains. We managed to save the team and some of the equipment!
quests/expedition_recruits_expendables/s: The Confederate combat station was attacked by space pirates. We provided support for our allies and received some soldiers and ammo in return!
quests/expedition_schemes_resources/plan: Radars spotted a research ship lost more than 20 years ago. There are no survivors, but some items are intact.
quests/expedition_schemes_resources/tras: The smuggler ship took us for a Confederate patrol, dropped their cargo and vanished from radar. Now that's speed!
quests/expedition_schemes_resources/stat: A big sale is carried out on the trading station Gita. These modules with data and resources we got almost for free!
quests/expedition_resources_expendables/: Military settlement in sector B-8 was severely affected by a fallen meteor. As a reward for our help we received some supplies.
Bugs detected on the Omega merchant ship! Luckily, we made it in time. The captain gave us part of the cargo as thanks.
We captured a small marauder ship! The Confederates took the bandits and we got the cargo.
quests/expedition_resources_recruits/pla: We found a colony badly damaged by an earthquake. We managed to clear the debris and even find survivors!
quests/expedition_resources_recruits/sta: The Ranger military base was attacked by pirates. The commander promised to reward us for providing air support.
We attacked the military renegades' base! After a short fight the enemy soldiers surrendered and we obtained access to the base's resources.
quests/expedition_recruits_schemes/plane: General! After learning who the owner of this ship was, a squad of mercenaries joined us taking the info-modules of their last employer along.
quests/expedition_recruits_schemes/stati: The slave station S.L.A.V.E ceased to exist because of us! All available resources are confiscated.
The gangster syndicate kidnapped a high-ranking officer. As a reward for his rescue, he sent us some recruits and secret data.
quests/expedition_star_4_1/description: An abandoned military base was discovered on a seismically active planet. We took the undamaged equipment and ammunition.
quests/expedition_star_4_5/description: We slipped unnoticed to the Sendai Syndicate base. We managed to mine the key components of the station and remove some valuable equipment.
quests/expedition_star_4_6/description: We managed to board a lone marauders' frigate. We transferred all the valuable items to our ship and delivered the bandits to the Confederation base.
quests/expedition_star_4_7/description: Smuggled goods were confiscated.  The bandits tried to resell a huge arsenal of weapons and ammo.  The buyer could not be tracked down.
quests/expedition_star_4_8/description: An abandoned military freighter filled to the brim with weapons and ammo was found. The ship was towed to the base.
quests/expedition_star_4_9/description: We barely had time to rescue these guys, General! The damaged engine of their ship was ready to explode any minute.
quests/expedition_star_4_12/description: The Iron Griffins mined the space station of the mercenaries. The soldiers were taken out just a few minutes before the explosion.
quests/expedition_star_4_15/description: We managed to pick up a few escape capsules and undamaged container with ammunition. Apparently, these guys have gotten into serious trouble.
quests/expedition_star_4_16/description: The training camp was not prepared for extreme weather conditions. We saved people and valuable resources from acid rains.
quests/expedition_star_4_18/description: Your fame grows,, General! The colonists of a rich planet shared their valuable resources with us.
quests/expedition_star_4_19/description: We helped a small merchant vessel to fight off the pirates. The captain of the rescued ship rewarded us with a resources box.
quests/expedition_star_4_20/description: A riot happened on the mining orbital complex. We helped to calm down the revolutionaries for a modest fee.
quests/expedition_star_4_21/description: Mineral deposits were discovered in the depths of a gas giant. All the resources are successfully extracted, brought on board and delivered to the base.
quests/expedition_star_4_22/description: We picked up a coded message, sent by the pirates. It was the coordinates of a secret warehouse located deep underground. The warehouse was found, the content was taken out.
quests/expedition_star_4_23/description: An abandoned mining station was discovered. Looks like it was left in a hurry - part of the extracted minerals still remained untouched.
quests/expedition_star_4_24/description: We helped to repair the power supply of a small industrial plant. The director personally thanked us and gave us a small gift.
quests/expedition_star_4_25/description: A pirate station for the processing of minerals was discovered. The bandits were eliminated, we took everything valuable.
quests/expedition_star_4_26/description: The mining station sent us an SOS signal. We have restored the power of the reactor and received a small reward in return.
quests/expedition_star_4_27/description: Looks like we found traces of a pirates' ambush. We found undamaged containers with resources in the burned barge's hold.
quests/expedition_star_4_28/description: We stumbled upon an abandoned civilian ship near the magnetic anomaly. Modest deposits of resources are found on board of the ship.
quests/expedition_star_4_29/description: Scanning of an asteroid ring revealed the presence of a foreign material. Next time the smugglers should hide their loot better!
quests/expedition_star_4_31/description: The on-board scanner recorded an asteroid field rich in minerals. We managed to process part of them onsite and bring them with us.
quests/expedition_star_4_34/description: We managed to reveal a stash belonging to the Sendai criminal syndicate.  The guards were absent, but we decided not to delay the return flight.
quests/expedition_star_4_38/description: A planetary science base appeared in the massive earthquake's area. We managed to save most of the personnel as well as some of their know how.
quests/expedition_star_4_39/description: A sunken station was discovered at the bottom of an Earth-like world.  We managed to bring some equipment and the data terminal to the surface.
quests/expedition_star_4_40/description: We found a working data terminal in an abandoned research station. We have just finished deciphering.
quests/expedition_star_4_41/description: Technology traders begged us not to render their station to the authorities, offering us a couple of info-modules. Let leave this between us, General.
quests/expedition_star_4_42/description: We discovered the Caramba pirates link, through which bandits exchange technologies. The source was not found, but we managed to download some data.
quests/expedition_star_4_43/description: DVD-discs - popular data storage devices of the distant past were found among the debris. The data recorded on them can be useful to us.
quests/expedition_star_4_44/description: We managed to open the drifting cordite safe. Looks like someone was very worried about the safety of these info-modules.
quests/expedition_star_4_45/description: Driller robots caused a riot at the mining space station. After dealing with the situation we received a small gift from the workers.
quests/expedition_star_4_46/description: An unmanned research station will fall soon on the planet judging by its trajectory. We hurried to pick up info-modules and remaining resources.
quests/star_1_complete/name: You completed Campaign 1: Thunder in Paradise!
quests/star_1_complete/description: Congratulations! The bugs on Gadalur have been destroyed and the New Eden system is free from the Swarm! The White Consul thanks you for your flawless leadership. Moreover, you have earned praise from the White Consul. He says your actions epitomised shrewd tactical analysis. With your permission I will add this: I am proud to have worked with you!
quests/star_2_complete/name: You have completed Campaign 2: The Swarm's Mother!
quests/star_2_complete/description: General, you did the impossible! The biomass on Corinth is defeated. The press is calling you The Confederate, with a capital C. Your name made headlines! Congratulations! I've received a message from the Council: they've nominated you for the New Confederate Heroes award. This is a great success!
quests/ch_1_s_1_complete/name: You have completed the side campaign: The Shadows of Strata!
quests/ch_1_s_1_complete/description: Congratulations, General! You kept the Iron Griffins from implementing their insidious plan. My informers are reporting that the spread of Zodiac has stopped. This is excellent publicity! The Council members have been bombarding me with messages asking us to contact them, but I would prefer that you get some rest.
quests/ch_1_s_2_complete/name: You have completed the side campaign: Union of the Forsaken!
quests/ch_1_s_2_complete/description: You found the colonists forsaken by the Confederation and defeated the Swarm's Mother. The horrors of the war against the bugs are in the past. The Aid system is free, thanks to you! Regretfully, Mark Wyrn was killed, but most of the colonists were rescued. They are very grateful. It is finally possible for them to stay and live a quiet life.
quests/ch_1_s_3_complete/name: You have completed the side campaign: Gorgon Pacified!
quests/ch_1_s_3_complete/description: General, you've done the impossible! The Swarm's Mother has been defeated, and the Black Consul rescued! Believe me, you will now be considered one of the most important figures in the Confederation! I would like to personally thank you for your tenacity, a trait of a true hero. Thank you!
quests/star_3_complete/name: You have completed Campaign 3: Rise of Machines!
quests/star_3_complete/description: Owing to your decisive actions the command cruiser of the Logos was destroyed and the Сallahan Machine Cult became the faithful ally of the Confederation! Great job!
quests/star_4_complete/name: You have completed Campaign 4: Ashes of Phoenix!
quests/star_4_complete/description: You managed to put an end to the invasion of the Logos soldiers at Phoenix Feather, saved billions of people and eliminated the Master of Machines. You deserved this victory, General!
quests/ch_2_1_complete/name: You have completed the side campaign: The Razor's edge
quests/ch_2_1_complete/description: Congratulations! You blew the lid off Tom Blaine's fraudulent operation and nabbed him from the pirates. Now he awaits the justice of the Confederation Court and hard labor in one of the prison factories! Reya Blaine has fled the Mor system, and her trail has been lost.
quests/star_1_finish/name: Exploration of the New Eden system completed!
quests/star_2_finish/name: Exploration of the Aurelia system completed!
quests/star_3_finish/name: Exploration of the Santum system completed!
quests/star_4_finish/name: Exploration of the Phoenix Feather system completed!
quests/quest_widge_test_quest_1/descript: "Tarantula" is captured by bugs. Somehow they managed to cause a failure in the air defense system , but the  engineers manually  powered off the guns.
quests/quest_widge_test_quest_2/descript: Tarantula was captured by the bugs. They somehow managed to cause a failure in the air defense system, however the technicians powered the guns off manually.
quests/quest_widge_test_quest_3/descript: Tarantula was captured by the bugs. They somehow managed to cause a failure in the air defense system, however the technicians powered the guns off manually.
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_01_1/descrip: Capture the objective and destroy the planet's defence
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_03_1/descrip: Deprive the enemy of the resource base and break his defense
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_04_1/descrip: Take control over the main channels of system
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_05_1/descrip: Capture the Machine temple to deactivate the defensive perimeters
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_06_1/descrip: Switch off the power shield to use the orbital bombing
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_07_1/descrip: Deprive the enemy of the opportunity to land on the planet
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_08_1/descrip: Capture the ammo of the strike cruiser Jaffa
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_09_1/descrip: Take control over the space gates of the Pandora system
quests/pvp_galaxy_1_mission_10_1/descrip: Capture the medical supplies to allow further advances
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_01_1/descrip: Capture a large shipment of valuable resources
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_02_1/name: Drilling rig in an asteroid formation
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_02_1/descrip: Destroy the saboteurs preparing an explosion at the core of the asteroid
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_03_1/descrip: Stop the enemy from starting the generator and destroying  the atmosphere of Utopia-4
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_04_1/descrip: Prevent the attack in Metropolis center
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_05_1/descrip: Capture the geomagnetic activity data recorded by the satellite to avoid ending up in the eruption zone.
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_06_1/descrip: Recapture the enemies' nuclear weapons. Act with extreme caution
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_07_1/descrip: Explore the depths of the mysterious asteroid
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_08_1/descrip: Capture the complex and interrupt the supply of fuel to the enemy
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_09_1/descrip: Capture the undamaged equipment from the old base
quests/pvp_galaxy_2_mission_10_1/descrip: Capture the blueprints of the Prism station to prevent the enemy from building a similar death machine.
quests/star_1_quest_01/description: We've evacuated the civilians from Dolores Prime to one of the new colonies. Resources are required to provide the army with all the things needed. First of all is metal. Let's build a Drilling platform.
quests/star_1_quest_02/description: The Drilling platform is installed. Now we can extract metal from deep underneath the planet's surface. Would you like to start right now?
quests/star_1_quest_03/description: We need a bigger army to stop the Swarm's invasion. Let's deploy the tactical headquarters and train new soldiers.
quests/star_1_quest_04/description: Excellent! We have the first soldiers ready to join the glorious ranks of the Space Infantry. Order the formation of an infantry squad at the tactical headquarters and we can start fighting the bugs!
quests/star_1_mission_01/description: The Dolores Prime garrison is too small to hold back the Swarm. We need to request backup from neighboring planets. The comm tower blocked by the bugs is in District 37. We need to clear the sector and retake the tower.
quests/star_1_mission_02/description: Command is bringing genetic samples created during the Super Soldier Program to the planet. We have been instructed to provide safe passage for the convoy through the battle zone.
quests/star_1_quest_05/description: The information we obtained when we threw the Swarm back from the tower allowed our engineers to design a war ammunition factory. Do you wish to give the order to begin construction?
quests/star_1_quest_06/description: The Munitions factory is ready. Let's order munitions and bring all of humanity's firepower down on the Swarm!
quests/star_1_quest_07/description: Command has sent us some equipment for the space infantry genetic module. This equipment will allow us to upgrade our fighters. However, we need crystallite to build it. This is an artificial mineral synthesized in a special crystallite mine.
quests/star_1_quest_08/description: General, I have just been told that the pit is operational. The scientists are awaiting your orders to begin synthesizing crystallite.
quests/star_1_quest_09/description: We now have all we need to build a Space Infantry Genetic Module. Let's get started with the construction right away!
quests/star_1_quest_10/description: General! The Genetic Module is at your disposal. Let's visit it and upgrade our infantrymen.
quests/star_1_quest_11/description: Our colony is growing rapidly. We need more space to build new structures. Let's explore the adjacent sector.
quests/star_1_mission_03/description: Now that the genetic material is safe, we have been instructed to destroy the genetic modules to ensure that the Swarm will not use the DNA of the Space Infantrymen to create a new species of bug. Let's start the clean-up immediately!
quests/star_1_mission_04/description: The colony governor gave us the coordinates of the Dinosaur secret facility. This is a military plant located on the planet Oberon. The planet was captured by the bugs - however, the plant is still holding. We must evacuate the scientists and get the secret designs out of there.
quests/star_1_mission_05/description: We've received a distress call from the mining colony on Gadalur. The message was sent automatically and we don't know what is going on there. If the colony was attacked by bugs we need to evacuate.
quests/star_1_mission_06/description: The colony on Gadalur was destroyed - however, several miners managed to escape. They told us about a huge bug which allegedly commands the others. If that is so, we will have to explore the places where the bugs are concentrated and find the Swarm species.
quests/star_1_mission_07/description: The density of the Swarm biomass on Gadalur exceeds that of the Swarm found at Dolores Prime. It means that the source of the invasion is right here. We found the Big Bad Bug and drove it into the canyon. It's time to purge the system of the Swarm.
quests/star_1_mission_07/campaign_comple: Here will be the text of congratulations on chapter completion. Two or three lines. I do not know what but something shall be there
quests/star_2_quest_01/description: Congratulations, General! The New Eden system is free from the Swarm but Earth is still at the mercy of the Martian invaders and we are at the very edge of space. There is a long way to go and we should start with the construction of a fuel station to refuel our ships.
quests/star_2_quest_02_01/description: General! Our exploration probes detected strange activity near one of our bases! We need to investigate this!
quests/star_2_quest_02/description: The station is completed. Now we can start the production of fuel and send the fleet outside of New Eden.
quests/star_2_side_01_01/description: General! Our intel ships encountered several colonies, which are hostile to the Confederation. Their coordinates can be found on the galaxy map. The Confederation has given permission for military raids against any of these.
quests/star_2_side_01_02/description: We can raid those colonies which refuse to support the Confederation. It will bring us resources, as well as the military aid of the White Consul.
quests/star_2_side_01_03/description: The Confederation appreciates our contribution to the fight against the Renegade Generals. The White Consul stated that he would continue supporting the generals fighting for the unification of the galaxy.
quests/star_2_side_01_04/description: Command has announced the beginning of a large operation to eliminate the Renegade Generals. If we join, we would get the support of the Confederation as well as additional units.
quests/star_2_side_01_05/description: General! The Confederation is gathering the fleets of the loyal generals in order to invade the Pandora system. If we join the operation, we will be able to get secret technology that will make us stronger.
quests/star_2_mission_01/description: We've received an emergency message from the Aurelia system. The Space Infantry's headquarters on Karradas was attacked by the Blue Swarm. It is not clear where the bugs come from, but our star fleet is the closest and ready to begin landing troops.
quests/star_2_mission_02/description: According to the intel data the bugs crawled from the technical catacombs under the city. These tunnels stretch for many miles around. We don't know how many creatures are hiding in them. The command is going to use gas and we won't allow the bugs to get outside.
quests/star_2_quest_03/description: Command is worried because of the lost labs on Nephrite. They are ready to send us some scientists to build a Science Center and develop upgraded munitions.
quests/star_2_quest_04/description: General! Now that we've built the Science Center, we can upgrade the power of our guns. Let's visit it and upgrade our air strike.
quests/gun_quest_01/description: A famous engineer named Lloyd Myers held some lectures on gun upgrades for our scientists in the Science Center. I suggest you test the benefits of those lectures in practice.
quests/gun_quest_02/description: General, we are requesting you begin an Air Strike upgrade program using the Confederation's designs.
quests/gun_quest_03/description: General, not long ago, we had a few lectures for designers and manufacturers of weapons of mass destruction. Due to them, we can upgrade Gravity Bomb.
quests/gun_quest_04/description: General, a request for upgraded military components has been received from the artillery department for the whole sector. The Artillery needs to be modified!
quests/gun_quest_05/description: General, the Black Consul has ordered that the technological complex that carries out airstrikes on enemy territory be upgraded. You need to upgrade Airstrike.
quests/gun_quest_06/description: General, the engineers say that a series of modifications is required to be able to continue using the gravity-bomb-launching complex.
quests/gun_quest_07/description: General, the Black Consul isn't satisfied with the current equipment at the artillery installations. You need to improve our Artillery!
quests/gun_quest_08/description: General, our military engineers are suggesting an upgrade of the airstrike. After the upgrade, the weapon will become more accurate. You have to approve the upgrade plan.
quests/gun_quest_09/description: General! Urgent message. Our R&D department has finished the development of an updated version of the gravibomb. It would be a mistake not to use it in future battles. Should we send an order to improve this type of fire support?
quests/gun_quest_10/description: General, our artillery units are asking for a technology that can improve their fire support. They think that their software is completely outdated. Should we allow them to update?
quests/citizen_quest_05/description: General, we need a bigger workforce to continue large-scale construction. After all, we cannot make our soldiers build their barracks themselves!
quests/citizen_quest_04/description: General! We will soon be unable to actively continue construction. The colony is short on personnel! We need to fix this.
quests/citizen_quest_03/description: General, our colony are gloomy and lonely. How about we make our colonists happy by adding decorations? Plus this might attract some new citizens.
quests/citizen_quest_02/description: The Hestia Fund will give the Family Hearth award to the colony that attracts the most citizens. We still have time to participate.
quests/citizen_quest_01/description: These are representatives from the Hestia Fund. They are willing to offer financial support to colonies that protect the institution of the family. Let's support this great initiative!
quests/star_2_quest_05/description: General! Our soldiers need a place to relax and forget about the horrors of war and about their lost limbs. Let's build a bar. Plus, a bar is a good place to find heroes.
quests/star_2_quest_06/description: I heard that Scarlett Ney showed up in our bar. Half of the galaxy thinks she is a criminal, and the other half considers her a hero. Anyway, she would be a mighty ally for us.
quests/store_quest_01_02/description: General! To further develop the colony and the army, we need to save up more resources. To do that, we need more crystallite warehouses.
quests/store_quest_01_01/description: General! To further develop the colony and the army, we need to save up more resources. To do that, we need more metal warehouses.
quests/star_2_quest_08/description: Our colony is pretty highly developed. We can now build a station to explore outer space.
quests/star_2_quest_09/description: General! Our probes have detected some strange activity near one of our bases! We need to investigate!
quests/star_2_quest_10/description: We used the sample armor suits taken from Tarantula to begin mass production. We can now train Peacemaker shock troops in our Tactical Headquarters.
quests/star_2_mission_03/description: There were more bugs than expected, and half of the vanguard troops were killed. Before launching any new operations, the White Consul has ordered to deploy a full-fledged military base on Karradas. We were ordered to clear the landing area for the transport ships.
quests/star_2_mission_04/description: The base established on Karradas badly lacks resources. Industrial warehouses with metal and crystallites have been found about one hundred and seventy miles to the east of here. We have been instructed to seize and confiscate the contents of the warehouses.
quests/star_2_mission_05/description: We've received a message on the private channel. The Secret Center for Bug Studies on Nephrit has asked us to assist in the capture of several samples of the Swarm that have escaped from the laboratory. Nephrite is a planet covered with jungles, so this won't be an easy task.
quests/star_2_mission_06/description: We're late. The new bug species, bred by mixing human DNA and the Swarm's biomass, destroyed all of the research center personnel. We need to regain control over the lab, take all the data and blow up the building.
quests/star_2_side_05/description: More and more refugees from Aurelia are arriving at our colony. People are scared, and many of them have lost their families. I think we should build several apartment modules for these refugees.
quests/star_2_side_06/description: General! Our colony has become a part of the Confederation's  program for the support of new worlds. We have to increase the number of citizens to get more military supplies.
quests/star_2_side_09/description: General! Our colony is experiencing a lack of crystal. To resolve this issue, we need to upgrade the crystallite pit, which will significantly boost our crystallite production. The engineers can start as soon as you give the order!
quests/star_2_mission_07/description: General! We've lost contact with the Tarantula military base, where the main Space Infantry garrison on Nephrite is located. Our drones were shot down near the base by the base's air defenses, so the only way to get there is to cross the jungle.
quests/star_2_mission_08/description: Base Tarantula was captured by the bugs. They somehow managed to exploit a glitch in the anti-aircraft defenses, but the technicians manually cut the power to the guns. Data indicates that the base has a number of Peacemaker armor suits. We can take and use them for our own purposes.
quests/star_2_mission_09/description: Urgent Message! Corinth IV is under attack from the Swarm's enormous forces. Command has thrown all the fleets in the area at it to stop the invasion. We should immediately prepare for landing... and, sir... this is my home planet.
quests/star_2_mission_10/description: The military Academy on Corinth IV trains the Space Infantry officers. According to satellite images, the bugs are concentrating forces to attack the Academy. We have been instructed to keep the security perimeter at all costs.
quests/star_2_mission_11/description: Apparently the Swarm's attack on Corinth is the last attempt to change the course of war. Deep underground we found a ship with the primordial biomass better known as the Mother. If we fight our way to the mine and destroy the Mother, the war for the Aurelia will be won.
quests/star_3_quest_01/description: General! The emissaries of the Machine Cult have just arrived. They offer to build a Reliquary to accept volunteers and train them in military skills. I'm sure the Cult knowledge will be useful!
quests/star_3_quest_02/description: The Reliquary allows the training of Machine Guards. These tenacious soldiers despise cowardice. Let us see how strong their hatred to enemies really is!
quests/star_3_mission_01/description: General! We've received an urgent message from the Machine Cult. The Santum system is attacked by the robots of the Logos. They captured the space station and are going to launch a nuclear strike against Сallahan. The Master of Machines asks to stop the launch.
quests/star_3_mission_02/description: Logos squads are trying to fight their way to the Central Reliquary to get the secret data. The attack caught the Cult by surprise and it seems that the Reliquary will be lost if we don't help.
quests/star_3_quest_03/description: In gratitude for help the Cult gave us a part of its genetic code. This will allow expanding the Machine Cult Genetic Module and using it to upgrade guardians.
quests/star_3_quest_04/description: The Machine's genetic code is a unique heritage of the colonization times, when Neotec created the first Masters of Machines. Perhaps we can create an ideal soldiers by upgrading the Cult fighters!
quests/star_3_mission_03/description: We received a signal from Circe, where the Machine Cult's genetic modules are. Logos landing ships have breached the defensive perimeter. They are after the Machine Knights' hereditary codes. Losing them will bring the Cult to its knees.
quests/star_3_mission_04/description: Logos concentrates enormous force to breach the defense of Circe. The Machine Cult needs time to withdraw the genetic code. If we can win back at least one of the military airfields we'll hold the robots with aircraft.
quests/star_3_quest_05/description: I was just told that a Machine Knight fleet has entered the system. These mighty warriors have been fighting Logos for decades. They are ready to join us at the order of the Master of Machines!
quests/star_3_mission_05/description: While the main forces of the Machine Cult have been concentrated on Сallahan, the Logos attacks the other planets. Several hours ago the robots attacked the resource bases on Orb III. The Master of Machines asks us to land and regain control of the planet.
quests/star_3_mission_06/description: General! We observed enemy transport activity in sector R-12. Our data shows that the Cult keeps military storage facilities there. Logos intends to extract their contents before our main forces arrive. Let's deliver a preemptive strike.
quests/star_3_quest_06/description: General, to detect new attacks of Logos robots, we need to scan the Santum system. Request permission to launch probes.
quests/star_3_mission_07/description: The Master of Machines gave us the coordinates of the Typhon military research center on Orb III. The base has been declassified and defined by the Logos as a priority target. Hurry up, we need to get to Typhon first!
quests/star_3_mission_08/description: During the defense of Typhon we've captured an enemy information module and found out that more than hundreds Devastators were delivered to Orb. These machines can wipe all life off the face of the planet in a few hours. We can't allow Logos to activate them!
quests/star_3_mission_09/description: General! Robots are leaving Orb III and moving to sector Zeta 9.  Judging by the signature of the object detected there it's a command cruiser of the Logos. Despite the lack of firepower we can try to attack it while the enemy is weak!
quests/star_3_quest_07/description: Our success in the war with the Logos has not gone unnoticed. Eric Claymore, the legendary hero and defender of the Phoenix Gates, has just arrived at the colony. You can meet him at the bar and discuss the terms of the joint campaign.
quests/star_3_mission_10/description: Great news! Our boarding team has just disabled the weapon systems of the cruiser. Now we have to capture the central reactor and prevent the Logos ship from passage through the space gate.
quests/star_3_mission_11/description: General! We can not get through to the reactor! An automatic turret blocks all ways. We have to deactivate the security system of the cruiser to reach the goal. If we can not deactivate it the boarding teams will be doomed!
quests/star_3_mission_12/description: Excellent work, sir! Turrets are turned off, the reactor is stopped. Wait... Oh no... I have just received a report ... Logos activated the self-destruct system of the cruiser. We have to mop up the landing deck immediately to evacuate the soldiers!
quests/star_4_mission_01/description: We detected a Logos intrusion in the Phoenix Feather system. The robots have attacked Fleya, the system's capital. First, the Confederation wants to evac the governor and his family. Our fleet is the closest one to Fleya. Will you give the order to deploy our troops?
quests/star_4_mission_02/description: An active evacuation of civilians takes place on the Fleya. The Confederate fighters cover the shuttles in the air and in the orbit, but the defenses of the central spaceport are about to fall. We are being asked to land and secure the perimeter.
quests/star_4_mission_03/description: Bad news, General. The robots broke through to the planetary guns. A few shuttles are down. The fleet in the orbit is under fire. If we don't retrieve the guns, the evacuation mission will fail.
quests/star_4_mission_04/description: The Logos attack the strategic targets throughout the system. Miners at the Bore-3 station have been attacked by their own robots. I think a diversion module of the Logos sneaked to the station. If we don't find it, all the resources of Bore-3 will be lost, as well as the miners.
quests/star_4_mission_05/description: The miners are safe, but the scanners have recorded the Logos in the technical unit of the Bore. As we know, the main life-support systems are located there. If the Logos gain control of the unit, it will make our lives significantly harder.
quests/star_4_quest_01/description: General, the analysts have provided some new details on a new system being explored at the moment. We cannot yet cross its borders, as the risk is too high. They recommend urgently improving our combat readiness.
quests/star_4_quest_02/description: General, we cannot let such unforeseen situations happen. We need to upgrade the home base, constantly monitor the enemy’s progress and take retaliation measures. Will you sign the order to proceed with this?
quests/star_4_mission_06/description: This is urgent! The attack on the tech facility was a trick. The Logos are about to blow up the thermonuclear reactor! Our analysts estimate that the explosion will destroy all of Boor's resource supplies. The system's economy would never recover from a blow like that...
quests/star_4_mission_07/description: Sir, Logos fleets come from sector XB- 6. Judging by the signature we are dealing with a battle station of enormous size. The Confederates are going to attack it with the Cult of the Machine. All loyal generals have already agreed to participate in the operation.
quests/star_4_mission_08/description: Good work, General - protective weaponry is disabled. Reinforcements are coming up but the main machine forces will be here first. We have reprogrammed several turrets on the landing strip. Now it is the perfect place for defense.
quests/star_4_quest_03/description: The Machine Cult on Сallahan has sent the blueprints for the production of the last generation cordite armor. Now we can create Cult Shock infantry squads:  the powerful Chaplains. Let's bring down their wrath on the Logos!
quests/star_4_mission_09/description: Judging by the station blueprints, the data cluster, which is a kind of a think tank for the robots is located on board. Even the Machine Knights were not able to capture this device, so get ready for fierce resistance.
quests/star_4_mission_10/description: Our engineers have started to crack the data cluster and here are the first results. The ZOG station is not just a battle center. It is a small spatial gate leading to the native system of the Logos called Platea.  Destroy the station and the invasion of the robots will be stopped!
quests/star_4_mission_11/description: Sir, I have just received a report from the Hive...  the defensive system of the most heavily populated planet in Phoenix Feather is completely offline. The residential areas are swarming with the Logos. We are capable of stopping this massacre, General. Orders the landing on the Hive!
quests/star_4_quest_04/description: General! The events on the Hive have shocked the residents of our colony. They ask for help in collecting and sending humanitarian aid to the planets of the Phoenix Feather. I think we can meet them halfway.
quests/star_4_mission_12/description: We lost contact with the Master of Machines on Glados. The comm channels are a mess! The colonial defense forces reported that the Cult's knights are attacking their garrisons! We need to send a fleet to find out what's going on there.
quests/star_4_mission_13/description: I can't believe it! The Machine Knights are killing the humans on Hive! Glados's garrisons fell! The satellites detected some ballistic missiles launched from the Cult's bases. They are heading straight for the planet's biggest cities. We must stop them.
quests/star_4_mission_14/description: An urgent message! Logos somehow hacked the Master of Machines's defense systems and uploaded modified directives. This explains the knights' betrayal and means that we must destroy the Master. There is no other way to save the Phoenix Feather!
quests/ch_2_1_mission_01/description: The owner of the ship Ulysses, Tom Blaine, has contacted us. He's been delivering parts for the Confederation's cruisers, but one of his vessels has been lost in the Mor system. Blaine is asking us to go to the planet Khem, where the Ulysses was last seen.
quests/ch_2_1_mission_02/description: The Ulysses was shot down by pirates from the Iron Griffins clan, who flew here from Aid. They set up an SOS beacon and an ambush! Our scanner has located their base, and we can't let them keep attacking ships like this.
quests/ch_2_1_mission_03/description: You have two new messages. The first is from Blaine: "My boys are gone forever, but now their deaths are avenged. I'm in your debt." The second is anonymous: "The crash of the Ulysses was arranged. It's all a setup! You can find proof on the planet Werb. Coordinates attached."
quests/ch_2_1_mission_04/description: We bumped into some unknown mercenaries and found the cargo the Ulysses was carrying. Looks like the vessel swapped out its real cargo for some discarded parts from the space cruiser graveyard around the planet Errato. We have to get to the bottom of this.
quests/ch_2_1_mission_05/description: We've captured a few pirates, and they say they made a deal with Blaine that got them the cruiser parts. But to find out how he profited from all of this, we need to access data from the offshore bank he used on Lokk 9 Station.
quests/ch_2_1_mission_06/description: Blaine was nearly bankrupt, so he did this to collect insurance payments from the bank equal to the value of the ship and the "lost" cargo. Confederation radar has determined his current location: Navi Base. We need to get over there before he leaves the system!
quests/ch_2_1_mission_07/description: The pirates got here first! The main group captured Blaine and left the planet. But it looks like those vultures have another hostage, too - a girl. They've barricaded themselves in the bunker. We've got to get her out - she might know something.
quests/ch_2_1_mission_08/description: I'm Blaine's sister, Reya. I found out about the fraudulent deal and didn't want to betray the Confederation, so I hid here and sent you that anonymous message. Tom found me and asked me to return to the team, but these vultures caught us off guard and took him to their Chrome Stronghold.
quests/scarlett_ney_mission_02/descripti: I've forced all the registrars to check all the ships from Archon. Now we know that our bird has visited the repair base Star Albion on Corinth. Most likely it is now owned by bugs. Would you like me to pack your bags?
quests/scarlett_ney_mission_04/descripti: A base of smugglers taking the weapons off the Balorian quarantined stations was located on the DLC. All we have is to clean-up the weapons factory the parts were delivered to, and then we can issue an invoice for Gadalur to Albion.

quests/spaceport_block_1/description_uni: Repair the spaceport and get access to new missions and a unique reward!
quests/spaceport_mission_pack_1/station: The fugitive scientist got infected by an unidentified virus. Our medicals specialists are performing an autopsy as we speak. I will let you know of the results as soon as I find something out, general.

quests/spaceport_mission_01/description: Right you are, Sir! We have located one of Genesis scientists. The source is the Zulu planet - on the furthest border. Be careful, general - Confederates lost connection with the Zulu colony about two months ago.
quests/spaceport_mission_02/description: About two hours prior to our arrival, an unknown craft has left Zulu. The ship landed on a small tropical planet in the same sector. General this could be our man!
quests/spaceport_block_3/description: Intel identified one more signal, but at the moment it is located outside of the zone accessible by our shuttles. In order to solve this problem we must modernize the main assault ship of the spaceport.
quests/spaceport_block_3/description_uni: Modernize the shuttle and get access to new missions and a unique reward!
quests/spaceport_block_4/description: General, the assault ship is currently being modernized for future missions. We will have to wait until the repair works are complete.
quests/spaceport_block_4/description_uni: Modernize the shuttle and get access to new missions and a unique reward!
