quests/spaceport_mission_06/description: Sir, I have bad news. There are a few raiders-exterminators riding on the tail of the rescue shuttle. Our pilot needs time to get rid of the bandits and land at the evacuation point. Hold on, general, I believe in you.
quests/praetorian_02_01/description: General, we need to have Walter Riffers hold a seminar on the applied principles of chess: how to predict the behavior of enemy forces.
quests/praetorian_02_02/description: A theoretical course on warfare developed by military analyst Walter Riffers.
quests/praetorian_02_03/description: General, please give your permission for us to hold a webinar that explains the most typical tactical errors to our soldiers. This webinar will be held by Jonathan Brown.
quests/praetorian_02_04/description: An open webinar held by the Black Consul's experts. The webinar will show examples of the most efficient tactical solutions when facing a massive advance by the enemy.
quests/praetorian_02_05/description: General, please give the order to analyze armaments used by the Confederation. These classes will feature classified data (Hummingbird clearance is a prerequisite).
quests/praetorian_01_01/description: General! Our fighters must complete a new infantry training program that is as realistic as possible.
quests/praetorian_01_02/description: The Council is demanding to hold a theoretical course in combat tactics developed specially for our soldiers by military analyst Walter Riffers.
quests/praetorian_01_03/description: The Black Consul has ordered our fighters to take a course developed by Noah Phoenix, the leading expert on open-space combat tactics.
quests/praetorian_01_04/description: General, allow us to hold a webinar that will show examples of the most efficient tactical solutions when facing a massive advance by the enemy.
quests/praetorian_01_05/name: The How and When of Counterattacking
quests/praetorian_01_05/description: We have developed a new program to improve our soldiers' self-control during retreats and at the beginning of counterattacks. You need to approve it if we are to proceed.
quests/praetorian_03_01/description: General, you need to launch a crash course designed to significantly improve the soldiers' physical capabilities.
quests/praetorian_03_02/description: General, I suggest you approve another seminar by Walter Riffers. This class is aimed at strengthening knowledge of the Behind Enemy Lines program.
quests/praetorian_03_03/description: The Council demands that we hold a course to build confidence on the battlefield. The course will be useful both for rookies and for experienced fighters and will be held by Noah Phoenix.
quests/praetorian_03_04/description: The White Consul is requesting that we have Noah Phoenix hold a course in the colony focusing on finding the enemy's weaknesses and anxieties, and how we can take advantage of them.
quests/knight_01_01/description: General, the Cult Guards eager to fight, but for many of them the upcoming landing will be the first. Training can not replace the experience of fighting on the front lines, but will help recruits survive in the first few minutes of the battle.shifts.
quests/knight_02_01/description: Knights are our unfailing battering ram in any battle. All the same, their weak point is their marching nodes, without which a soldier simply cannot move. They need to be upgraded.
quests/knight_02_02/description: The knights have shown themselves quite capable in recent battles, but veterans say that things will only get worse. The Master of Machines has asked that these squads be reassembled to prepare them for the next battle.
quests/knight_01_02/description: Guards are selfless soldiers who are not used to retreating, but there will be little use for them in the battles to come. They need new equipment and total retraining.
quests/knight_03_01/description: Chaplains are fanatical believers. For them, faith has replaced food, sleep, and reason, but unfortunately it cannot replace antiquated environmental suits. Our technicians are prepared to replace their reactors so the Chaplains can continue their crusade in the name of the Machine.
quests/knight_01_03/description: General, the engineers of the Black Consul are reporting that you must start the technical maintenance routines and upgrade the guardians’ hardware. If you attend to this quickly, you will get a bonus from the reserve fund.
quests/knight_03_02/description: General, the Black Consul is ordering an urgent upgrade of the chaplains’ equipment. If you act quickly, you will be rewarded with money and supplies.
quests/knight_02_03/description: General, our analysts believe that the knights’ armor and weapons can be improved. We have the technical capacity to do that. Will you sign the order?
quests/cleaning_quest_03_01/description: General, the shuttle crash has caused some inconvenience for the workers and is disturbing the base's transport logistics. Order the area to be cleared of debris.
quests/cleaning_quest_03_02/description: General! Our engineers say that fuel spills at the base are negatively affecting the health of the colonists. We need immediate clean-up!
quests/cleaning_quest_03_03/description: General, our loaders has been deactivated. The scanners show that the problem is coming from foreign bodies in the mechanisms. Will you order them to clean up this junk?
quests/upgrade_hero_02_01/description: General, please give order to Eric Claymore  to take Front Line Battle Preparation, the course prescribed to him by our military psychologists.
quests/upgrade_hero_02_02/description: General, the Black Consul thinks that Eric Claymore is making mistakes in melee combat. It would be worth your while to attend to this issue and retrain the soldier with Mr. Rigby's "Destruction through Pain" program.
quests/upgrade_hero_02_03/description: General, our military tacticians believe that Eric Claymore should go through Professor Pierce's advanced military qualifications course. Unfortunately, he hasn't taken our request to heart. Please order your soldier to take the class, he'll listen to you.
quests/upgrade_hero_02_04/description: Our specialists recommend holding a training course developed especially for Eric Claymore. General, please sign off on his class schedule and order him to regularly attend classes.
quests/upgrade_hero_02_05/description: General, Eric Claymore is in good physical shape, and his psychological condition could allow us to make him an even more capable and effective soldier. We've prepared a special training program; please order Claymore to undergo training.
quests/defence_upgrade_04/description: General, The Master of Machines has given us new optical devices. This safety glass and these gun sights will help us efficiently repel attacks by the renegades, and they'll also prove useful in conducting our own attacks.
quests/defence_upgrade_05/description: The Reliquary is offering to reinforce our defenses by adding a few new watches and patrols. The Machine Cult will send guards - additional patrols will provide them with newfound stamina and endurance.
quests/defence_upgrade_06/description: Every defensive point should be upgraded and equipped with a training ground. This will help our soldiers prepare for battle, rather than cool off between shifts.
quests/trash_splitter_build/description: Let's build a garbage splitter. This will provide us with an additional source of fuel and decrease the amount of garbage.
quests/cleaning_quest_02_01/description: General, please give us orders to explore and find a site for the manifold and to lay power grids and pipelines for our backup air duct.
quests/cleaning_quest_02_02/description: General, please confirm the new territory exploration plan so we can conduct geodetic surveys and search for ways to improve the tech we're currently using.
quests/cleaning_quest_02_03/description: General, the Council requests we find a way of improving our perimeter's line of sight and thus increasing the efficiency of our defenses.
quests/cleaning_quest_02_04/description: General, please remove the old facilities so we can construct an updated communications network and secure additional sectors to build in.
quests/cleaning_quest_02_05/description: General, please recycle the old shuttles and the satellite module parts located in occupied territory. The workers have been told to look for intact tech.
quests/star_2_side_04/description: Our colony is growing rapidly. We need more space to build new structures.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_01/description: Scarlett Ney seems bored whenever she's not in a fight. HQ receives complaints about her mischief. Let's redirect her energy for our best interests.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_02/description: Scarlett Ney has been ordered to undergo Dr. Rigby's psychological testing. The psychologist believes this will improve her self-control.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_03/description: General, please approve this course developed specially for Scarlett Ney. It includes the Sole Survival and Macedonian Shooting programs.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_04/description: General, we need your approval to launch a program aimed at improving the relationships between Scarlett and her operators who help her choose tactics on the battlefield.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_05/description: Our experts developed a program that will gradually increase the workload of Scarlett Ney's workouts. We await your approval, General.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_06/description: A crash course in the specifics of using melee weapons. The course methodology was developed for Scarlett Ney. If you approve it, we will start right away.
quests/upgrade_hero_01_07/description: Scarlett Ney seems bored whenever she's not in a fight. HQ receives complaints about her mischief. Let's redirect her energy to meet our interests.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_01/description: A research team led by Lee Wayne went missing from the Strata system. They were working on class A nutrition supplements. The Council believes their disappearance has something to do with the Iron Griffins pirate clan near the planet Chion. We've been asked to find Wayne.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_02/description: We tailed the Griffin ship to planet Eugene. They tried to break away in an asteroid belt, but we shot them. The pirates' escape pods have landed at the equator. We should attack them now while we know their location!
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_03/description: When questioned, the Griffins mentioned the ship Shiva, a written-off cruiser they use to carry cargo. They won't say what the cargo is. Probably smuggled goods. We've determined where the ship is, so now we can intercept it.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_04/description: General, the Shiva's cargo is a combat stimulators pack code-named Zodiac. It was developed by Dr. Wayne himself. Right now he's probably in an underground Griffin factory on the planet Salm. The Council has OK'ed a capture mission.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_05/description: Wayne wasn't at the production facility. He was transferred to another base. There's no point in looking for him as long as the Griffins remain funded. First we need to hit their in-house bank in Eugene's orbit.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_06/description: The pirates' financial support is disrupted. Our informers are reporting that the Griffins' command is fleeing and a self-destruct sequence has commenced in their coordination center on Chion! We need to seize their data block ASAP.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_07/description: Chion is in utter chaos. We eliminated the remaining Griffins and obtained their data block. Judging from that info, the Mandrake base must contain information on the location of Wayne and his people.
quests/ch_1_s_1_mission_08/description: General, Wayne is in the lab on the planet of Camp 8. According to our informer, we can find both our scientists and the first test subjects of Project Zodiac there. We need to stay sharp. I suggest we proceed with the assault.
quests/invasion_swarm_quest/description: General! Our planet was attacked by the Swarm's monsters. If we don't hurry they'll capture it, and we'll lose a key piece of the springboard for our offensive.
quests/invasion_attack_quest/description: General! Our planet has been captured by the Swarm's monsters. Influence points count has been decreased. Let's wipe those bugs out!
quests/invasion_pirates_quest/descriptio: General! Those pirates have attacked our planet!  If we don't hurry, we'll lose part of our resources.
quests/invasion_2_pirates_quest/descript: Pirates are attacking our planet in the Machine Cult's territory. We've got to stop them before they snag everything valuable!
quests/technology_plasma_scissors/descri: Allows you to clean up the technical garbage
To get this technology, complete a chain of territory cleanup quests.
quests/invasion_defend_mission_04/descri: Pirates are about to loot the colony. We need to drive the them away!
quests/invasion_mission_02/description: The bugs are trying to capture the planet! Protect the colony!
quests/star_2_quest_defend/description: General, we need to fortify the colony's defenses. Build some defensive guns - they will help us repel the enemy's attacks.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_01/description: We intercepted a signal from P-7 Station, which orbits planet Gemini in the Aid system. The Swarm captured Aid 20 years ago and the Confederation evacuated the colonists. No one is expecting us except bugs and the signal's sender.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_02/description: Someone was here and left a message. "This is Mark Wyrn. Tornton base is under siege - we need the Union's help!" Data indicates that Mark Wyrn, head of the Gemini colonists, was killed 20 years ago. This looks like a trap.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_03/description: I'm Mark Wyrn, head of the Union of the Forsaken. We formed this union exactly 20 years ago, when the Confederation abandoned us. Your aid has come too late. Want to be of use? Drive the bugs back to the defense turrets.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_04/description: Great! No one from the Union of the Forsaken is leaving Aid until we defend this system! This is our land! Don't worry, I have a plan. First, we need to regain control over the Way-3 coordination center on Gemini.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_05/description: I'm at Way-3. Sensors are showing the colonies' power shields as dead. Have your soldiers replace the power supply units, or we won't last. Start with Gemini. We have a power supply unit, so fight your way to the shield generator and install it.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_06/description: Now for Pier-2. The shuttle that was carrying the new power supply unit crashed in the wasteland. The on-board computer failed and the crew had to abandon ship. By now it must be swarming with bugs. Go there and get the power supply unit.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_07/description: There's a group here called the Recluses. They refuse to fight for our cause and are hiding on the ship Katana. Traitors! Not long ago, they captured the power supply unit from the Zyx colony. We will retrieve it with your help.
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_08/description: Varrus colony has a similar problem. They lost contact with the power supply shuttle. It was probably captured by the Swarm or the Recluses. The ship is hovering in orbit and is not responding. Hurry! The colony's shields will stop soon!
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_09/description: The Swarm wasn't stopped by the orbital guns, which were disabled due to a failure at the Zyx power plant. When we figured out the problem we found it to be full of bugs, and we were short on people. Now, we can break through and restart the generator!
quests/ch_1_s_2_mission_10/description: We're getting close to the generator. Damn it! Unbelievable! The Swarm's Mother! She's been here all these years, absorbing the power of the generator. General, the place is full of... *static* ...we need backup... *static*.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_01/name: The Gate to the Gorgon System
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_01/description: Thanks to your success in the Aid system, we can isolate the Swarm on Baloria again. The Confederate fleet is moving to the space gate. Your job is to destroy the asteroids that are keeping the Titan ships from entering the Gorgon system.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_02/description: Our next step is deploying an operations HQ on Tsuntree. The old orbital guns will keep the ships away - they'll recognize us as a foe. Drop a task force from the recon shuttles and disable the control station.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_03/description: We conducted an initial bombardment of Tsuntree, but our ships are unable to land for now. To land and start deploying the HQ, we need to wipe out the bugs still on the planet's surface.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_04/description: During the First Isolation of Baloria, the quarantine modules were supervised by the Tsuntree's Blackwall base. To get the modules running again you have to go there and start the generator.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_05/description: Looks like the modules have incorrect coordinates. They should have been saved in the main computer on Icarus-2 Station, which orbits Baloria. Go there and enter the correct coordinates into the autopilot system.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_06/description: While retreating, most of our team... *static* ...the Swarm is everywhere! We entered the correct coordinates into the Icarus-2 station's computer, but we urgently need... *static* ...requesting evac... *static*
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_07/description: General, after the quarantine network was activated in Baloria's orbit we lost contact with the Bellerophon cruiser. It went off course and might take the modules with it. Go to the ship, find out what happened and alter its route.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_08/description: Emergency! We don't know what happened but it looks like the Mother downed the Hades by discharging organic matter. The ship crash-landed on Baloria. The Black Consul and his men hid in the old Polyphemus observatory.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_09/description: The motion tracker shows that the Black Consul and his men have barricaded themselves in the observatory's dome. We will send a rescue shuttle if you can get inside and open the dome. Hurry, or the bugs will get there first!
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_10/description: Baloria is no longer a threat. The Mother on Tsuntree is now our target. Our soil scorcher, which was holding her back, is disabled. We need to get it running again and I think I know who can fix this problem.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_11/description: The soil scorcher is a provisional measure. The only way to kill the Mother forever is by destroying Tsuntree. I've given the order to deploy thermonuclear charges in the deep mines. Clear the path for my engineers.
quests/ch_1_s_3_mission_12/description: We planted the thermonuclear charges, but one of the engineering teams got trapped when the tunnel entrance collapsed. We can't stop the timer now! We need to extract them before it blows!
quests/research_station_upgrade_01/descr: General, we can now build a probe station. Research probes are the driving force of progress!
quests/invasion_swarm_tutorial_quest/des: General! We've received an SOS signal from our planet in the Aurelia system. It looks like a Swarm invasion. We need to help our planet as soon as possible, or else we risk losing it!
quests/invasion_pirates_tutorial_defend/: General! We've spotted a few pirate shuttles near our planet in the Aurelia system. They seem to be preparing to launch an assault on our planet. Let's show them who's in charge here!
quests/invasion_swarm_tutorial_quest_att: We're too late. The Swarm's monsters captured our planet and slaughtered the civilians. If we don't cleanse the planet we run the risk of the Swarm moving toward our base.
quests/defence_upgrade_01/description: I don't mean to upset you, but the Council demands that we improve our defenses. This is the only way to keep our industry funded and keep obtaining new technologies.
quests/defence_upgrade_02/description: Notice: The Confederate Defense Structure Inspection board (CDSI) has toughened the defense standards for Confederate colonies in all systems.
quests/defence_upgrade_03/description: General, since the Confederate colonies are being attacked more often, the head of CDSI has toughened the requirements for settlement defenses. To get new technologies, we have to upgrade our existing defensive structures.
quests/bar_upgrade_01/description: I don't mean to bother you with trifles, but our psychologists suggest we make our bar more comfortable. They think this might improve the overall performance of our elite fighters.
quests/upgrader_units_praetorian_upgrade: I'd like to point out that troops are waiting for a transfer to a new level. I strongly suggest you consider upgrading the Space Infantry Genetic Module.
quests/barracks_praetorian_upgrade_01/de: General, I have some news for you. The Council has given us six months to expand our Tactical HQ and maximize the number of recruits we take in.
quests/factory_upgrade_01/description: General, new types of munitions appeared in the market. The re-equipment of the munitions factory is necessary for their production. In addition, the new equipment will take up less space in production halls: we will be able to produce more munitions.

quests/side_expedition_quest_01/descript: Eatan Emmers contacted us, a research executive with the Planet Exploration Department. His co-worker Adrianna Frost and her team went missing in Green's Belt. Emmers is worried. For the second time he is asking to launch four probes which receive data from planetary sensors. He hopes to find traces of the team.
quests/side_expedition_quest_02/descript: General, I don't mean to annoy you, but we have been contacted by Emmers again. Here's his message. "The Strata system the Confederation has discovered may contain planets visited by the expedition led by my... Adrianna! I beg you, let me launch a couple of probes there!"
quests/side_expedition_quest_03/descript: Thank you, General! The other day, I found a sensor left behind by Adrianna's team. Unfortunately, it contained no info on their future plans, but the find itself is enough. Now I know she's alive! Once again, I will need your approval to launch some probes to the next system the expedition is most likely headed to!
quests/space_bank_build/description: Сongratulations, General! You got access to the construction of the Galactic bank. Build it and you will get tax robot which collects credits for you.
quests/weather_control_build/description: General, the engineers suggest that we build a weather station in the colony. It will help us monitor weather conditions and make adjustments to the shuttle launch schedule. Besides, its frequencies will interfere with atackers’ comms. You need to approve the implementation plan to start the construction.
quests/monument_war_build/description: General, our social analysts believe that we should start constructing the Eternal Memory monument. It will become an embodiment of your high moral principles and support the soldiers whose family members died in battles for the Confederation.
quests/monument_war_end_build/descriptio: There is a growing number of ultra-militarists among the colonists who support the idea of attacking the Confederation planets. The Council is asking you to consider constructing the Apogee of War monument as a reminder of the fact that war mostly brings destruction and misery.
quests/sky_hammer_build/description: General, the colonists have collected signatures in support of constructing the Sky Hammer building - the symbol of the power of the Cult of the Machine. All we need is funds!
quests/eternal_guard_build/description: The Black Consul is asking you to commemorate the memory of the fallen knights and construct the Eternal Guard monument to increase the loyalty of the residents and citizens of friendly colonies. Please confirm the start of construction.
quests/master_of_machines_build/descript: General, the Association of Confederate Historians is asking you to start the construction of the Conqueror of Worlds monument - a symbolic reminder about the Epoch of Colonization. Will you consider their proposal?
quests/monument_conquerors_build/descrip: General, our sociologists have conducted a survey and found out that most colonists are wondering why there is no Master of Machines at such a large base as ours. I think the people will appreciate your fixing this blunder.
quests/new_year_quest_robot_1/descriptio: Many planets suffered from the Invasions this year, so the Council have sent Robo-Santa to peaceful colonies. He will take gifts for children from the attacked settlements. Christmas tree will be a symbolic reward for us as contributors. We should help, General.
quests/new_year_quest_robot_2/descriptio: Trade Association of Free Worlds and the Hestia Fund offer to organize a New Year's fireworks in the colonies who are actively involved in the Make a holiday program. We only have to collect more donations.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_01_lock: General, I recommend we reconnoiter the Omega System. We haven't heard any news from that system for twenty years, so we have no idea what might be out there...
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_01/desc: We are prepared to dock at the Guard-13 defensive station. It appears to be the epicenter of a protracted battle! We must defend the command staff!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_02/desc: The station is almost completely under Swarm control. We've got to go to the combat center first so we can check the station's modules and reinitialize the defense system.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_03_lock: To prolong the station's service life, the service deck was closed down for several years. To use it, we'll have to start its life support systems back up.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_03/desc: The system says some of the crew could still be trapped in the station's living quarters module, but the main corridor to that module is locked down. We'll have to use the service deck to access it.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_04/desc: General, the central bridge is the key to the station's defenses. We've got to clear the bugs out of it if we want to make any progress!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_05_lock: The corridor to the living quarters has been locked down by the security system. We have to repair the control terminal and wait for the system to reboot.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_05/desc: General, I bet there are still survivors in sickbay! The station commander has asked us to clear the sector and get the survivors out.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_06/desc: The system is showing an unidentified object stuck in Guard-13's hull. It looks like a huge asteroid tore into the hull and got stuck. That's where the bugs are coming from!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_07/desc: The bugs arrived at our station on huge biomass asteroids! We've got to fry the Swarm along the outer perimeter so our crew can start repairing the hull.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_08/desc: During the attack, nearly all of the life support systems in the Guard's generator module were disabled. To start them working again and open the access corridor, we need to get to the data center computers.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_09/desc: General! An alarm has just been triggered in the quantum reactor coolant system! Looks like the bugs have hit that module, too. I'm sure you understand the danger we're in if we don't handle this immediately!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_10_lock: A fault in the water purification system has flooded the rec room with water. The leak has been fixed, but it'll take some time to pump the water out.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_10/desc: These bugs really multiply in the rec room's artificial warmth. We've got to destroy the Swarm's eggs, unless we want another invasion!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_11/desc: The force field generators will shut down any minute now, leaving Guard-13 defenseless! General, we've got to clear the generator module of Swarm bugs so our repair crew can get to work.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_12_lock: General, we can't leave the station until control over its key systems has been restored. Plus, the platforms leading to the Sieve need to be repaired!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_12/desc: General, a huge asteroid filled with bugs is hovering right by our station. We can stop these attacks if we destroy it, but first we have to clear out the Sieve and prepare to launch our attack from there.
quests/event_1_red_swarm_mission_13/desc: General, if we destroy the bugs on that asteroid, our techs will be able to push it away from the station and destroy it with the planetary guns. It's time to put a stop to these Red Swarm attacks once and for all!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_main_complete/d: We've beaten back the Swarm's attack on Guard-13's key modules! Now it's only a matter of time until we have full control of the station once more. The commander expresses his gratitude and requests that we keep squashing more bugs. There are plenty of them out there!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_complete/name: All Red Swarm bugs on Guard-13 destroyed!
quests/event_1_red_swarm_complete/descri: General, the Capital's on the line. You just destroyed the last round of bugs, and the White Consul wants to personally thank you for delivering this station from the Red Swarm! Guard-13 is now ready to serve Vector Omega once more.

resources/scarlett_ney_equipment_2/descr: One of the Space Infantry special unit's combat knives. Made of extra tough alloys. The cordite blade of this knife can easily cut through metal sheets and enemy armor.

resources/scarlett_ney_equipment_12/desc:
An illegal modification of the
Z-104 implant. Popular with smugglers and head hunters. It promotes tissue regeneration and helps its users survive critical injuries.
resources/scarlett_ney_equipment_13/desc: Developed by Confederate engineers and used for blatant propaganda. The flag-shaped hologram and the White Consul's ardent speech instantly fills all true patriots with an eagerness to fight.
resources/scarlett_ney_equipment_14/desc: Unlike other targeting systems, digital tag grenades transmit the target's coordinates to the gun battery. Remember, to remove the protective seal before throwing.

things/scarlett_ney_equipment_1/descript: This large caliber gun was made by Ian Stross, who is the best gunmaker of the Melo Nova system. It's got two shooting regimes and a heavy hilt to split sculls in the close combat.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_2/descript: One of the Space Infantry special unit's combat knives. Made of extra tough alloys. The cordite blade of this knife can easily cut through metal sheets and enemy armor.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_3/descript: A lightweight armor suit made of inertial materials. Besides offering superb protection, it is lightweight, which provides greater mobility than other armor suits.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_4/descript: A unique modification of the CLV army pistol, also known as the Nevada. It uses special phosphorus ammo, inflicting severe damage and thermal burns.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_5/descript: This armor vest is used by Confederate special forces. Nanite fibers increase range attack defense by <font color="#fff66f">25%</font>. Female versions are available by special order.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_6/descript: The latest model of tactical helmets from Neotech Corporation. Cordite offers reliable protection for the head, and the thermal scanner detects the target's vulnerable areas.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_7/descript: Ammo with a high content of radioactive elements. It is very popular with pirates, who are not daunted by the obvious problems of storing it.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_8/descript: Reliably protects the hand up to the forearm. The blade cuts steel like paper, and the pulse laser built into the glove can hit distant targets.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_9/descript: This became widely used during SKO thanks to its painkilling properties. Also, it improves reflexes and motor functions somewhat, increasing long-range combat efficiency.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_10/descrip: The Sirus is a unique visor with a two-way neural interface that directly improves brain function. This results in an increase of all of the soldier's combat abilities.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_11/descrip: While developing this armor, which increases melee attack defense by <font color="#fff66f">25%</font>, scientists were inspired by certain insects whose chitin shells offer superb protection without hampering movement.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_12/descrip:
An illegal modification of the
Z-104 implant. Popular with smugglers and head hunters. It promotes tissue regeneration and helps its users survive critical injuries.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_13/descrip: Developed by Confederate engineers and used for blatant propaganda. The flag-shaped hologram and the White Consul's ardent speech instantly fills all true patriots with an eagerness to fight.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_14/descrip: Unlike other targeting systems, digital tag grenades transmit the target's coordinates to the gun battery. Remember, to remove the protective seal before throwing.
things/scarlett_ney_equipment_mascot/des: +100 for health, +5 and short-distance attack and +15 long-distance attack of the character
things/eric_claymore_equipment_1/descrip: This badge is a special award for the most zealous followers of the Cult. They say it is handed only in the presence of the Master of Machines.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_2/descrip: One of the most useful models of the day. Significantly stimulates the growth of the muscles and make the implant owner more fatigueproof and strong.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_3/descrip: The ultra-light armor made of the rarest metals alloy that increase range attack defense on <font color="#fff66f">25%</font> .
things/eric_claymore_equipment_4/descrip: The modified version of the force glove G-9. Pilot engines are reinforced and cordite inserts safely protect fingers and hand. This glove wearer can punch a man through.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_5/descrip: One of the best arms for the close combat. Each shot includes about 29 thousand particles of hot plasma each being able to cut a man through.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_6/descrip:
Officially banned in the Confederation, since they are classified as narcotics. Significantly improve reflexes and reduce reaction time. Side effects are possible.
Increase the speed.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_7/descrip: IR-4 «Apostle» is quite popular with snipers. Sensors provide the crystal visibility of the target while the inserted scanner reveals the most vulnerable sites.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_8/descrip: Reliable and easy- to- handle sward good both for attack and protection in the close combat. Special nanite cover of the blade prevents loosing the cutting edge.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_9/descrip: Comfortable, simple and reliable helmet. Increases protection from melee attacks by <font color="#fff66f">30%</font> and thus saves your head. The secret is quite simple - The Face of Valor is strictly custom made for each individual knight.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_10/descri: Stylized to match the Machine Cult Inquisitor emblem, this medallion is in reality a transmitter beacon for combat droids. With such protection you can jump right in the middle of the battle and not be afraid of anything!
things/eric_claymore_equipment_11/descri: Incorporates an entire army of nanobots-healers and can immediately heal almost any wounds. Right after the healing, the Guardian requires a full recharge.
things/eric_claymore_equipment_12/descri: Installed on the side of the striking arm. Makes the strike much stronger thanks to the mechanical servo-driver. Thor should be used most efficiently with the heavy weaponry for close combat.
things/mascot_eric/description: The Machine Cult has developed a unique device. This chip is inserted into the armor of a knight to increase his combat efficiency.

waypoints/waypoint_1_proto_mission/descr: General! We've found the remains of our partners. Apparently, this was a well thought-out trap. Prepare to defend this place!
waypoints/waypoint_1_proto_mission_after: General! We can now proceed further. Sending reinforcements.
waypoints/waypoint_2_proto_mission/descr: Apparently, something huge and scary was here earlier. We need to investigate.
waypoints/waypoint_2_proto_mission_after: General! I am dying to discover who controls the Swarm. Perhaps we will find the answer later.
waypoints/waypoint_3_proto_mission/descr: This is going to be an INFERNO! Our recon data shows that something huge is moving toward us! Prepare the best you can!
waypoints/waypoint_1_attack_mission_1/de: Sector 4 is lost. The Council demands we retake these territories. They have strategic value to the Confederation!
waypoints/waypoint_2_attack_mission_1/de: We detected massive gatherings of the Swarm in the area. Be extremely cautious. These beasts are too dangerous.
waypoints/waypoint_3_attack_mission_1/de: This place is devastated. And if we retreat, our base will look just like this in a few days.
waypoints/waypoint_4_attack_mission_1/de: Ha! That was easy. Time to grab a cold one at the bar.
waypoints/waypoint_1_swarm_defend_missio: General, the bugs attacked Sector 4! I can't figure out how they got by our radars. We're trying to drive them back!
waypoints/waypoint_2_swarm_defend_missio: The bugs are getting more numerous. They probably emerged from the cruiser that crashed nearby. Hang in there!
waypoints/waypoint_3_swarm_defend_missio: General! We need to protect this sector at all costs, or else we will lose the adjacent territories in 24 hours!
waypoints/waypoint_4_swarm_defend_missio: This is the Swarm's last wave! Prepare the best you can!
waypoints/waypoint_5_swarm_defend_missio: Damn it, those bugs stained my boots!
waypoints/waypoint_2_defend_mission_3/de: General! The Shock troops will improve the situation but keep vigilant!
waypoints/waypoint_3_defend_mission_3/de: The bugs have decided to slaughter us. Well, good luck to them!
waypoints/waypoint_4_defend_mission_3/de: Ha-ha! Come here, you bastards. You'll never win! Kill them all!
waypoints/waypoint_5_defend_mission_3/de: General! Good job. The colony's cleansed from those filthy bugs!
waypoints/waypoint_1_defend_mission_4/de: General, we've detected a few pirate shuttles in Sector 21! What the hell do they want here? We'll try to find that out.
waypoints/waypoint_2_defend_mission_4/de: Looks like this was a spontaneous attack. Maybe their recon drone reported that the sector was uncontrolled!
waypoints/waypoint_3_defend_mission_4/de: We pushed them back to the quadrant edge. Just give us a few minutes and we'll give 'em hell!
waypoints/waypoint_4_defend_mission_4/de: Ha-ha! Come here, you bastards. You'll never win! Kill them all!
waypoints/waypoint_5_defend_mission_4/de: General! Good job. The colony's protected from those filthy bugs!
waypoints/invasion_2_pirates_defend_miss: The pirates are using our transport systems! Don't let them fly off with their loot, General.
Haha! Their loot turned out heavier than they expected. Our scouts say that reinforcements have arrived, probably more thugs.
These pirates need resources so badly that they've sent their elite troops to fight for them! Looks like they really can't afford to lose.
The pirates are attacking the residential sector! They must have decided the perimeter here looks more vulnerable. Let's prove them wrong!
They still managed to invade this sector before we could get here. Uhoh. Ambush! Squad, form a circle!
The pirates want to surround us. As if that could defeat the warriors of the Cult!
The pirates are attacking our outer perimeter. Why would they do that? There's nothing for them here!
Looks like that was just a recon mission. But why those cargo shuttles, then?
They're trying to cart off parts from the weather station and the planetary gun! We cannot let that happen!
waypoints/star_1_mission_01_waypoint_1/d: General! The fighters are approaching the Comm Tower. Movement detected ahead!
waypoints/star_1_mission_01_waypoint_2/d: The bugs are moving in from District 38! Don't give up the sector!
waypoints/star_1_mission_02_waypoint_1/d: The genetic samples are safe, for now. Our soldiers are moving on to the next area.
waypoints/star_1_mission_02_waypoint_2/d: Our radars are detecting a new wave of bugs! Prepare to defend this place!
waypoints/star_1_mission_03_waypoint_1/d: General! We're taking losses! Activate the kinetic shields!
waypoints/star_1_mission_03_waypoint_2/d: General! We're taking losses! Activate the kinetic shields!
waypoints/star_1_mission_03_waypoint_3/d: Time to test the Armtex warheads in action!
waypoints/star_1_mission_04_waypoint_1/d: A whole army of bugs is heading this way! Red alert!
waypoints/star_1_mission_04_waypoint_2/d: The bugs are more numerous! *static* Stand your ground!
waypoints/star_1_mission_04_waypoint_3/d: Evac shuttles approaching! Wait for the scientists to evac!
waypoints/star_1_mission_05_waypoint_1/d: The mines are swarming! *static* they're attacking from everywhere *static*
waypoints/star_1_mission_05_waypoint_2/d: *static* General, we're taking losses! The bugs are getting more numerous.
waypoints/star_1_mission_06_waypoint_1/d: A new specimen of the Swarm is nearby. Keep moving.
waypoints/star_1_mission_06_waypoint_2/d: Our fighters have found biological traces of an unknown specimen! The bugs seem to have found them...
waypoints/star_1_mission_07_waypoint_1/d: General, our radars have detected something huge. Looks like we've found it!
waypoints/star_1_mission_07_waypoint_2/d: We're fighting our way to the last area! Following the Big Bug.
waypoints/star_1_mission_07_waypoint_3/d: The monster! Attention soldiers! Get in position!
waypoints/star_1_mission_07_waypoint_4/d: The sector is clear. Sending transport ship.
waypoints/star_2_mission_01_waypoint_1/d: General! The radars have gone crazy. Prepare for a massive enemy attack!
waypoints/star_2_mission_01_waypoint_2/d: The enemy is approaching from the left flank. We need to regroup now!
waypoints/star_2_mission_01_waypoint_3/d: They switched tactics. The main force is moving towards the eastern wall. Get in position!
waypoints/star_2_mission_02_waypoint_1/d: Our engineers activated the valve opening mechanism. Keep the bugs in the target area!
waypoints/star_2_mission_02_waypoint_2/d: Our radars are detecting a new wave of bugs! Prepare to defend this place!
waypoints/star_2_mission_02_waypoint_3/d: We gassed most of the bugs in the catacombs. All you need to do is clear the given area.
waypoints/star_2_mission_03_waypoint_1/d: White Consul speaking. We've been in Karradas's orbit for an hour! What the hell for?! Quickly destroy the bugs in the drop zone.
waypoints/star_2_mission_04_waypoint_1/d: General, our squad is in the drop zone. Awaiting further instructions.
waypoints/star_2_mission_04_waypoint_2/d: Enemy's forces are concentrated in the adjacent sector.
waypoints/star_2_mission_04_waypoint_3/d: We're so sick of these insects! Let's break through again.
waypoints/star_2_mission_05_waypoint_1/d: The radar shows that you are close to the test subjects.
waypoints/star_2_mission_05_waypoint_2/d: Continue pursuit. I repeat, continue pursuit.
waypoints/star_2_mission_05_waypoint_3/d: Make sure those bastards are dead and take blood and tissue samples.
waypoints/star_2_mission_06_waypoint_1/d: General, we found no survivors. But there are plenty of bugs! We'll try to break through to data storage.
waypoints/star_2_mission_06_waypoint_2/d: We have the data. Let's plant explosives and get out of here.
waypoints/star_2_mission_07_waypoint_1/d: Enemy activity detected. Prepare for an attack!
waypoints/star_2_mission_07_waypoint_2/d: Soldiers are one square from the base, but there's movement on radar! The enemy's close.
waypoints/star_2_mission_07_waypoint_3/d: General, we are clearing the area and moving to the base.
waypoints/star_2_mission_08_waypoint_1/d: We are at the base. Attention, squad! We are on red alert.
waypoints/star_2_mission_08_waypoint_2/d: Our cargo must be here somewhere.
waypoints/star_2_mission_08_waypoint_3/d: Containers of cargo detected. We're clearing the area and extracting them.
waypoints/star_2_mission_09_waypoint_1/d: The landing was successful. We are reconnoitering the area and moving deeper into the sector.
waypoints/star_2_mission_09_waypoint_2/d: Large gathering of bugs detected. Confrontation inevitable. I'm temporarily interrupting our comm link with HQ.
waypoints/star_2_mission_09_waypoint_3/d: General, we've spotted a huge wave of the Swarm right in front of our squad!
waypoints/star_2_mission_10_waypoint_1/d: A whole army of bugs is heading this way! Red alert!
waypoints/star_2_mission_11_waypoint_1/d: You are nearing the epicenter of organic activity.
waypoints/star_2_mission_11_waypoint_2/d: The bugs are multiplying! *static* Stand your ground!
waypoints/star_2_mission_11_waypoint_3/d: The Swarm is protecting the biomass. This organic matter looks like the it's Mother!
waypoints/star_2_mission_11_waypoint_4/d: The sector is clear. Sending transport ship.
waypoints/star_3_mission_01_waypoint_1/d: General, the first control console isn't reacting to commands! It seems the power supply has been damaged. But the countdown has already started...
waypoints/star_3_mission_01_waypoint_2/d: The position at the second console is defended, and the timer has been stopped. The order to cancel the launch has been received. Let's clear out the sector and get back to the main computer.
waypoints/star_3_mission_01_waypoint_3/d: Our specialists need more time to cancel the launch. I recommend taking a defensive position at the main computer.
waypoints/star_3_mission_02_waypoint_1/d: These robots are significantly more dangerous than the ones we've come across before. Proceeding to analyze their tactical and technical characteristics.
waypoints/star_3_mission_02_waypoint_2/d: Our enemies are combat robots that were created at some point by humans to protect strategic targets. How careless...
waypoints/star_3_mission_02_waypoint_3/d: The Reliquary is defended. The enemy is gathering their forces to recapture the sector. Team, assume your positions and prepare to repel the assault.
waypoints/star_3_mission_03_waypoint_1/d: The defensive perimeter of the base got hit hard during the attack, but I'm sure we can hold out. Deploying defenses.
waypoints/star_3_mission_03_waypoint_2/d: I'm receiving reports about new Logos ships landing in sector Gen-3. It's gonna get hot.
waypoints/star_3_mission_03_waypoint_3/d: The last wave of ships is on the approach. Three minutes to combat readiness.
waypoints/star_3_mission_04_waypoint_1/d: Entering zone E-1. Sliders have been spotted in airport buildings; possible ambush. Team, set up a defensive perimeter.
waypoints/star_3_mission_04_waypoint_2/d: Observing the enemy's superior forces. Backup required. I repeat, backup required.
waypoints/star_3_mission_04_waypoint_3/d: The sector is almost clear. The robots are preparing to breach. Hold the perimeter! For the Master and the Cult!
waypoints/star_3_mission_05_waypoint_1/d: General, we've disembarked successfully, but the enemies have detected our presence. The first robots are already on the approach.
waypoints/star_3_mission_05_waypoint_2/d: We need to capture the fuel station. Without it, the robots will start to have problems.
waypoints/star_3_mission_05_waypoint_3/d: The sector has been cleared, and the station is under control. Let's move out and head home.
waypoints/star_3_mission_06_waypoint_1/d: Scanning the sector. Depots detected in zones B4, C3, and F7. Conducting offensive recon.
waypoints/star_3_mission_06_waypoint_2/d: We've fought our way into the heart of the sector. The enemy is putting up weak resistance. This is all too easy...
waypoints/star_3_mission_06_waypoint_3/d: General, I recommend testing the heavy knight squads in battle. The landing party will arrive in a few minutes.
waypoints/star_3_mission_06_waypoint_4/d: I knew it - a large group of robots is approaching. The knights arrived just in time. Get your weapons ready!
waypoints/star_3_mission_07_waypoint_1/d: General, we've arrived on time, but the Typhon's gate is closed for some reason. Deploying on-site defenses.
waypoints/star_3_mission_07_waypoint_2/d: Typhon here. It hasn't even been one Callahan year, and you've already arrived. The robots have almost reached us. It's time to do your job!
waypoints/star_3_mission_07_waypoint_3/d: What's taking you so long? We won't open the gate until there's no robots left on the other side!
waypoints/star_3_mission_07_waypoint_4/d: Obviously they're not going to let us in. Well then, let's wrap this up quickly and get out of here...
waypoints/star_3_mission_08_waypoint_1/d: General, we're in luck! The base has a self-destruct mechanism installed! If we can get to the control console, we've won.
waypoints/star_3_mission_08_waypoint_2/d: A large detachment of enemies is moving in our direction. Let's repel the first attack and fight through to our goal.
waypoints/star_3_mission_08_waypoint_3/d: Our specialists need some time to hack into the console. Cover them!
waypoints/star_3_mission_09_waypoint_1/d: Recon complete; let's set up an LZ. We've finally paid those buckets of bolts a return visit...
waypoints/star_3_mission_09_waypoint_2/d: The runway sector has been cleared, let's head toward the entrance gates.
waypoints/star_3_mission_09_waypoint_3/d: A large group of robots is headed right for us. Team, regroup before the final assault.
waypoints/star_3_mission_09_waypoint_4/d: I can see the gates. Welcome to Logos, boys. For the Master and the Cult!
waypoints/star_3_mission_10_waypoint_1/d: According to our intel from the recon, entire hordes of robots are headed right for us... There's more than a hundred of them! Now it's gonna get hot!
waypoints/star_3_mission_10_waypoint_2/d: Greetings, General. I've encountered these toasters before. There were just too many of them at the Phoenix Gate...
waypoints/star_3_mission_10_waypoint_3/d: We're almost finished mopping up. Just a bit more, and these damn robots will have nowhere to run!
waypoints/star_3_mission_11_waypoint_1/d: I can see the cruiser's AI. If we can hack it, we can turn off the security system. We'll have to fight our way to it at any cost.
waypoints/star_3_mission_11_waypoint_2/d: I've been hearing reports of unidentified activity in the target zone. It looks like something big. Wait for reinforcements.
waypoints/star_3_mission_11_waypoint_3/d: The unidentified object is approaching. It's a huge robot! Get ready, General!
waypoints/star_3_mission_12_waypoint_1/d: The first squad is ready to move up and mop up the deck. Cover them.
waypoints/star_3_mission_12_waypoint_2/d: I'm waiting for the second squad to arrive. Assume defensive positions. We're gonna get out of here, boys.
waypoints/star_3_mission_12_waypoint_3/d: There isn't much time left... Let's wait for the last squad to arrive and move out to the shuttles right away.
waypoints/star_3_mission_12_waypoint_4/d: The robots have set up an ambush at the shuttles. We've got some Stompers left! Show them what you're made of!
waypoints/star_4_mission_01_waypoint_1/d: The Logos continue to shoot down more and more Confederation shuttles! We need to mop up the sector before evacuating the civilians.
waypoints/star_4_mission_01_waypoint_2/d: There is the residence of the governor. Civilians will escape through the back gate. Our task is to distract the robots.
waypoints/star_4_mission_01_waypoint_3/d: The White Consul is on the line. Why are you still on the planet?! I order you to immediately load up and take off. No more objections.
waypoints/star_4_mission_02_waypoint_1/d: We are entering the spaceport sector. The enemy is coming from several directions. I am requesting reinforcements.
waypoints/star_4_mission_02_waypoint_2/d: A large group of enemy troops is moving from the northwest. Repel the attacks and break through to the evacuation shuttles.
waypoints/star_4_mission_02_waypoint_3/d: You must provide cover for the civilians during the evacuation. I advise you to defend the rescue shuttles.
waypoints/star_4_mission_03_waypoint_1/d: The robots have had time to prepare for our arrival. The assault will not be easy. I am sending reinforcements.
waypoints/star_4_mission_03_waypoint_2/d: Our engineers need time to reprogram the guns. Do not let the robots break through to the control panel.
waypoints/star_4_mission_04_waypoint_2/d: ... We ... have... communications problems. *interference* The mass of the asteroid... creating interference.. <CONNECTION LOST>
waypoints/star_4_mission_04_waypoint_3/d: <CONNECTION ESTABLISHED> It seems that the outer sheathing of the station and the rock are creating signal interference. Be careful, General.
waypoints/star_4_mission_05_waypoint_1/d: *interference*... I am detecting stompers on the lower levels... *interference*... Reinforcements... *interference*
waypoints/star_4_mission_05_waypoint_2/d: *interference*... They are getting in from below.. *interference*... Control the stairways...<CONNECTION LOST>
waypoints/star_4_mission_06_waypoint_1/d: *interference*... Reactor... *interference*... The station robots ...assembled to... defense. Requesting reinforcements.
waypoints/star_4_mission_06_waypoint_2/d: The sector has been cleared, and the reactor is under control. Let's move out and head home.
waypoints/star_4_mission_07_waypoint_1/d: General, the systems predict serious resistance from the Logos. I advise you to take up the defense here.
waypoints/star_4_mission_07_waypoint_2/d: The devastator is destroyed, but it has seriously thinned out our forces. Requesting reinforcements.
waypoints/star_4_mission_07_waypoint_3/d: Engineers have started hacking the panel. The robots will certainly try to stop them. You know what to do, General.
waypoints/star_4_mission_08_waypoint_1/d: The Cult's elite troops flew to our aid. Troops: hold your position until reinforcements arrive!
waypoints/star_4_mission_09_waypoint_1/d: General, it is difficult to underestimate the importance of information stored here! I beg you, try not to break anything...
waypoints/star_4_mission_09_waypoint_2/d: The lower level has been cleared. I see the data cluster. And the superior enemy forces too, unfortunately.
waypoints/star_4_mission_09_waypoint_3/d: The enemy is going to destroy the equipment to prevent us from getting to the data. Troops: keep up the defense, the Cult needs this information!
waypoints/star_4_mission_10_waypoint_1/d: The first charge is set. It is now the robots' turn to defend their spatial gate. And I'll try to make sure that they fail...
waypoints/star_4_mission_10_waypoint_2/d: The captured data cluster has allowed us to take control of the entire defense system. Now, the turrets will attack the station owners.
waypoints/star_4_mission_10_waypoint_3/d: The central sector has been cleared. Troops: take up the defense. We are setting the second charge.
waypoints/star_4_mission_10_waypoint_4/d: I see approaching enemy superior forces. Hold the defense and set the main charge. The robots will not give up easily...
waypoints/star_4_mission_11_waypoint_1/d: We are clearing the commercial sector. I observe movements in the apartment modules. An ambush is possible. Remain vigilant!
waypoints/star_4_mission_11_waypoint_2/d: Scanners are not able to detect any civilians... It seems that there are only robots left...
waypoints/star_4_mission_11_waypoint_3/d: We are entering to the residential sector. The enemy is coming from two directions. Troops: block the street and wait for reinforcements.
waypoints/star_4_mission_11_waypoint_4/d: The residential sector has been cleared. Finish off the remaining robots and return to base. We must be on time next time...
waypoints/star_4_mission_12_waypoint_1/d: Troops: take up a position by the gates of the Cult garrison. There is something about the silence inside that I do not like...
waypoints/star_4_mission_12_waypoint_2/d: Callahan gears! These knights betrayed the Master and the whole Machine Cult! Death to the apostates!
waypoints/star_4_mission_12_waypoint_3/d: Join us to learn what the real power is. If you refuse... then we'll just destroy you.
waypoints/star_4_mission_12_waypoint_4/d: Do not listen to the traitor! We will destroy the apostates and return honor to the name of the knights. For the Master and the Cult!
waypoints/star_4_mission_13_waypoint_1/d: The A-1 quadrant has been cleared. We have to go without delays, so the enemy won't have time to launch missiles.
waypoints/star_4_mission_13_waypoint_2/d: We did it, General. The launch has been stopped. We need only one last break out.
waypoints/star_4_mission_14_waypoint_1/d: How dare you enter the Temple without the permission of the Master? Now you will all die...Except those who will join us.
waypoints/star_4_mission_14_waypoint_2/d: You have gotten yourselves into a trap, haha. Nobody can beat the personal guards of the Master.
waypoints/star_4_mission_14_waypoint_3/d: General, the temple has been completely captured, and the Master of the Machines is destroyed. We won, I guess...
waypoints/swarm_tutorial_waypoint_1/desc: General! We're here, awaiting reinforcements. Hold on!
waypoints/swarm_tutorial_waypoint_2/desc: General! Get ready to repel the attack!
waypoints/swarm_tutorial_waypoint_3/desc: We're almost finished with them! We need one final push!
waypoints/swarm_tutorial_waypoint_4/desc: General! Hold formation! For the Confederation
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_01_waypoint_1: General, we need to hold back the bug attacks until we destroy most of the asteroids!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_01_waypoint_2: Damn it, they are too many of them. Hold on!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_01_waypoint_3: These asteroids will never end! I hope our guns don't give out!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_02_waypoint_1: We've landed on Tsuntree. Awaiting further instructions.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_02_waypoint_2: Proceeding to the destination *static*. Two squares to go to reach the orbital guns.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_02_waypoint_3: Our squads have reached the orbital guns. Give us the order to disable them!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_03_waypoint_1: The bombardment wasn't very accurate. There are lots of bugs left on the planet's surface. We must destroy them!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_03_waypoint_2: They're coming from underground. Their nest must be in the planet's crust.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_03_waypoint_3: General, we can't lose more people! Be careful!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_04_waypoint_1: General, we are on Tsuntree. Awaiting your orders.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_04_waypoint_2: There are lots of bugs here. Their main forces seem to be concentrated by the generator.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_04_waypoint_3: We're trying to get through to the generator. How numerous *static* beasts?!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_05_waypoint_1: Our squad landed on Icarus-2. Sensors show that they're surrounded by hundreds of bugs!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_05_waypoint_2: General, we cannot delay. We will do our job and get out of here!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_05_waypoint_3: If we continue fighting, we'll lose. We must retreat!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_06_waypoint_1: General, our boys are surrounded by bugs! We need to extract them ASAP!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_06_waypoint_2: We are breaking through *static* I have never seen so many bugs in one *static*
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_06_waypoint_3: We've reached our soldiers. Now we just need to evac them.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_06_waypoint_4: The bugs won't retreat! We need backup!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_07_waypoint_1: The task force is on board. General, they need to reach the main section.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_07_waypoint_2: The radars are going crazy. Our boys must be having a tough time!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_07_waypoint_3: Bellerophon is still following an incorrect course. Hurry!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_07_waypoint_4: The ship's controls are almost disabled. No time to lose!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_08_waypoint_1: The Black Consul is somewhere inside. Don't let the bugs get to him first!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_08_waypoint_2: The Black Consul's team has contacted us via backup comm devices. They need help now.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_08_waypoint_3: The scanner shows that you are a few squares away from your destination!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_09_waypoint_1: The Black Consul is here! We're holding the bugs back.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_09_waypoint_2: Send a rescue shuttle. We don't have much time!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_09_waypoint_3: Are you mocking us out there? Damn it, send a shuttle to our sector now! I said now!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_09_waypoint_4: We have contact with the rescue shuttle's pilot. Thank you. Almost perfect.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_10_waypoint_1: We've activated the soil scorcher. The bugs don't seem to like that.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_10_waypoint_2: They are getting more numerous! Stand your ground!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_10_waypoint_4: The scorcher is almost done. We're pulling up stakes!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_11_waypoint_1: We've activated the soil scorcher. The bugs don't seem to like that.
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_11_waypoint_2: They are getting more numerous! Stand your ground!
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_12_waypoint_1: General *static* we've lost contact with Taylor *static* Our navigation devices are disabled...
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_12_waypoint_2: General, we are moving blindly *static* No contact with HQ... *static*
waypoints/ch_1_s_3_mission_12_waypoint_3: There are lots of tunnels here! *static* Goddamn hole!
waypoints/waypoint_1_defend_tutor_pirate: General! Hold on! Destroy the pirates!
waypoints/waypoint_3_defend_tutor_pirate: They'll find nothing but their deaths here! Kill them all!
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_01_waypoint_1: General, our troops have landed on the planet Chion. We're performing initial recon.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_01_waypoint_2: We intercepted a few messages on a private channel. The griffins seem to be preparing for a large-scale attack.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_02_waypoint_1: Enemy activity detected. Sectors 2 and 4 are controlled by the enemy.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_02_waypoint_2: The griffins have nowhere to go. Get ready for resistance on their part!
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_02_waypoint_3: We're clearing the territory. Do it clean, like in training.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_03_waypoint_1: This is Falcon. Chameleon, respond. We're landing on the surface of the Shiva cruiser.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_03_waypoint_2: General, they don't want us here! Initiating Protocol Game Warden. Let's surround the pirates.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_03_waypoint_3: Remember, General: our primary task is to get the griffins' cargo.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_04_waypoint_1: General, we must totally annihilate the production facilities. Please focus on this task.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_04_waypoint_2: I've received an urgent message from the Council: You are to take a few samples of Zodiac.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_04_waypoint_3: Be careful! Radar shows the griffins are preparing a counterattack.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_05_waypoint_1: We are orbiting Eugene. Commencing operation.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_05_waypoint_3: Our experts connected to the shared network. We need time to complete the decryption!
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_06_waypoint_1: General, we don't have much time. Self-destruct sequence already initiated!
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_06_waypoint_2: We reached our target. They're not going to give us the data block without a fight.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_06_waypoint_3: The griffins are taking heavy losses. We need to take advantage of this and capture the data block.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_06_waypoint_5: Data block retrieved. Let's get out of here!
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_07_waypoint_1: General, we are on Salm. The Mandrake is within sight.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_07_waypoint_2: Our soldiers need to stay sharp. The infrared cameras are showing lots of armed people at the base.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_07_waypoint_3: We've broken through! Scanning main server.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_07_waypoint_4: We have the info on Wayne's location.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_08_waypoint_1: General, our recon data shows that the first test subjects of Project Zodiac are already in the lab. Be careful.
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_08_waypoint_2: We're taking fire *static* The griffins are retreating *static* What's... *static* wrong with the comm?
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_08_waypoint_3: Proceeding to Sector 4. General, we seem to have a problem...
waypoints/ch_1_s_1_mission_08_waypoint_4: The pirates and the Zodiac spawn are destroyed. Lee Wayne and his people are safe.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_01_waypoint_1: We've been able to hold back the Swarm's attacks. Our squad is moving to the signal transmitter.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_01_waypoint_2: I have good and bad news. The good news is that we have the transmitter. The bad news is that more bugs are approaching!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_02_waypoint_1: What the hell?! There are some humans here. They look like scientists. They're trying to survive the massacre.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_02_waypoint_2: This might be the team led by Wyrn, the guy who left that message on the transponder.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_02_waypoint_3: Let's extract these poor bastards. They're badly wounded so get the medics.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_03_waypoint_1: Protect the remaining turrets, or the colonists will have a difficult time.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_03_waypoint_3: Brace yourselves, guys, we'll do those beasts in!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_04_waypoint_1: We've landed in the Coordination Center. Exploring the sector.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_04_waypoint_2: No time to talk, General! It's too hot here!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_05_waypoint_1: The shield generator must be here somewhere. We'll try to fight our way to it.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_05_waypoint_2: Shield generator located. We are moving to the adjacent square.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_05_waypoint_3: The bugs are attacking! Protect the generator at all costs! I repeat, at all costs!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_06_waypoint_1: Our boys are breaking through to the shuttle! Let's give them support.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_06_waypoint_2: That was a tough battle. With your permission I will praise the soldiers on your behalf.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_07_waypoint_1: Attention all soldiers! Hold back the enemy!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_07_waypoint_2: Excellent! Reinforcements are here. Fortify positions!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_07_waypoint_3: No retreat! *static* Hold back the enemy in this sector! You copy? Hold back the enemy *static*
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_08_waypoint_1: The power supply unit must be here somewhere. We're waiting for the scanner to locate it.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_08_waypoint_2: General, the scanner spotted the power supply shuttle we need.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_08_waypoint_3: Our engineers are working. The soldiers need to cover them.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_09_waypoint_1: Stay sharp. There's quicksand all around. Remember that as you fight!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_09_waypoint_2: We're fighting our way *static* The generator is in the next *static* I repeat, next sector.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_10_waypoint_1: Soldiers are inside the power plant and awaiting further orders.
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_10_waypoint_2: General, we have a problem here. There are more bugs here than I have ever seen!
waypoints/ch_1_s_2_mission_10_waypoint_3: That's the Mother! Damn it, is she huge! I've never seen anything like it!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_01_waypoint_1/d: It looks like the Ulysses has been wrecked! But what did those vultures leave behind? Let's head deeper into the sector.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_01_waypoint_2/d: We've detected a nearby comm tower. Something tells me that's where we'll find some answers.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_01_waypoint_3/d: This beacon was sending out an SOS signal. The Ulysses flew here to "help"!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_02_waypoint_1/d: It looks like the events on Aid gave our pirates a severe case of paranoia. This whole place is mined like you wouldn't believe! Time to use our top-secret explosive weapon: BOMB-PIGS!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_02_waypoint_2/d: The corridors here are so long! I recommend we regroup before storming the next hall.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_02_waypoint_3/d: While we were finding a way around, the pirates rigged their own base with explosives! Hah, serves them right!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_03_waypoint_1/d: The markings on this container match the ID of the cargo that was supposedly lost with the Ulysses. We've got to see if this is really the missing cargo!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_03_waypoint_2/d: Give us the container and nobody gets hurt!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_03_waypoint_3/d: These pirates aren't Iron Griffins. Looks like there's another party involved with the Ulysses incident!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_03_waypoint_4/d: I checked the cargo ID number. This container holds planetary cruiser weapon parts. We can't let the pirates get their hands on them!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_04_waypoint_1/d: ... mountain of scrap is interfering with the signal ... *static* ... need to collect data on-site ... *static* ... ensure the engineer's safety.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_04_waypoint_2/d: Looks like this scrapheap is teeming with pirates, but those radar emplacements are the only antennae around. Taking them out will shut off the vultures' communications.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_04_waypoint_3/d: We're not going to find anything valuable here now. Let's try to at least capture a couple of prisoners.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_05_waypoint_1/d: We've boarded the station, and the first round of enemy troops is nearly here. I don't think we can expect a very warm welcome!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_05_waypoint_2/d: I can see the computers with the data we need. We have to grab them before the ships get away. Squad, regroup for our next assault!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_05_waypoint_3/d: We've got the data. But escaping this hornet's nest won't be an easy task!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_06_waypoint_1/d: The pirates have outrun us yet again! It looks like they've attacked Blaine's mercenaries. But where is Blaine himself?
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_06_waypoint_2/d: We can't let Blaine escape. We've almost got him! Maybe we can find some helpful info on the computers down below.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_06_waypoint_3/d: We need time to examine this archaic computers. Cover us, General.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_07_waypoint_1/d: I can see the bunker. Looks like Blaine's mercenaries already tried to get in there earlier. Squad, get ready to storm the bunker!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_07_waypoint_2/d: We've got the hostage. Let's head home!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_08_waypoint_1/d: Our troops have landed in the mountains. We still have to reach the Chrome Stronghold, and the pirates aren't exactly happy to see us.
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_08_waypoint_2/d: We're nearing the enemy's location. Squad, be on your guard and get ready for our assault!
waypoints/ch_2_1_mission_08_waypoint_3/d: We've got Tom Blaine, but the pirates won't let us just walk out of here with him. Get ready to fight!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_01_w: We got here just in time. The commander’s guard is barely hanging on. Let’s help them!
This is the commander of Guard-13 Station. Glad to see you here at such a difficult time. We’ll take any help we can get, General.
It looks like the bugs have captured all of the passages to the captain’s bridge. Our engineers can fry them all, but we’ll have to hold out.
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_02_w: The Sword Center is ours, and the engineers have started working.
Radar picking up increased bug activity in the Shield Combat Center. I recommend we regroup.
The bugs are attacking from the Tablet Center! We have to break through. Calling reinforcements.
The station’s security system is partially online. I’m starting decryption of the module status reports.
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_03_w: The door to the living quarters is locked, but we can hack our way in. Escort an engineer to the control panel.
The engineers are hacking the door open, but the bugs are incoming. Hold this position!
Getting through that door is taking longer than we anticipated, but there might be survivors inside.
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_04_w: The bugs have dug in on the platform, and we’ll never get through on our own. Calling for reinforcements!
It looks like the bugs sense our presence—they’re flooding in from all directions! Our best option is to hold off the attack from this position.
Radar’s picking up movement from a large mass of bugs. Our reinforcements will arrive just in time for the next wave.
Looks like we have to beat back one last wave. The bugs are in no hurry to abandon the other modules, but they’ll have us to deal with soon!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_05_w: Fury squad speaking. We’re holding out in sector M-3, and we’ve got the medical staff with us. The situation is under control, but you’ve got to hurry.
The survivors are in sight, but the bugs are coming too fast. Let’s cover the medics and wait for reinforcements.
I just got news that the remaining bugs are moving towards our position. Defeat them and the sickbay is ours!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_06_w: An asteroid has ripped right into the station! Scanning for Swarm species and biomass.
This asteroid is almost entirely made up of Red Swarm biomass. This is probably how the bugs got to the station.
Radar’s picking up some large objects—a Red Howler is moving towards us, along with something else we can’t identify. Hang on, things are gonna get hot!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_07_w: Turns out the asteroid isn’t so big after all, and removing it won’t be too difficult, but first we have to destroy these bugs.
Too many bugs here! Send reinforcements!
You did it, General! Repairs are already underway.
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_08_w: The bugs have overtaken the Data Center and are approaching our position from the south-west! I recommend we set up defenses.
Swarm activity detected on the north and east lifts. Squad, strengthen the northeast defenses!
The bugs are attacking from all sides. I recommend circle formation!
Reports say a large object is incoming. It’s a Red Howler! Exercise caution, General!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_09_w: The Red Swarm loves the warmth given off by the reactor, so it looks like the bugs have decided to make themselves at home here. Let’s show them what our warm welcome is like.
This is the station commander. A giant creature we call the Stick Bug is inbound on your position. Exercise extreme caution!
I feel like the strongest bugs are concentrated here. They must want to lay their eggs in the reactor room!
We cannot allow the bugs to reach the reactor! If it fails, Guard-13 Station will be powerless! Hold them back, General!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_10_w: This place is filled with these nasty Swarm eggs. We’ve got to destroy them all!
Our scanners are having some trouble with the area holding the Swarm eggs. Better safe than sorry — I’m sending reinforcements.
The Rec Room is almost clear. One last large wave. Looks like the bugs are furious that we destroyed their eggs!
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_11_w: Now I understand why the generators are close to shutting down... The bugs damaged them badly. We need to clear the way and send in a repair team.
The majority of the bugs are now coming from the old section of the hull called the Sieve. Looks like that’s where the second source of these attacks is located.
Guard-13 Station’s generator module is secure. Advancing towards the Sieve.
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_12_w: The Sieve is absolutely teeming with bugs. We have to handle this threat before we can land on that Swarm asteroid.
Those old turrets are proving pretty useful. I recommend we use them for cover. Especially now that the bugs have us surrounded!
The Sieve is clear. Preparing for the final assault.
waypoints/event_1_red_swarm_mission_13_w: Our landing was a success, but the bugs are fighting hard to protect their territory. We’ve got a tough battle ahead.
Our extermination squad is now deep inside the asteroid. I recommend hunkering down and holding off a few waves here. Our enemies will fight to the last bug!
Our scanners read significant activity in the depths of this huge chunk of biomass. The Swarm is throwing all it has against the invaders. Sending reinforcements!
We’re almost there, General. Time to make these pests regret they ever came here!

worldmap/event_1_red_swarm/description: The wormhole to the Omega System is open, and Red Swarm bugs are attacking the Guard-13 station.
worldmap/event_1_red_swarm/description_s: We've successfully opened the Wormhole to Vector Omega, a gigantic black hole that has been inaccessible for a couple of decades now. The Confederation's Guard-13 Station had been brought to full combat readiness and has been attacked, it seems. We must investigate the situation.
